passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَخْصُوصَةً بِعَظِيمِ عِنَايَةِ اللَّهِ وَكَرِيمِ نَظَرِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ makhshûshatan bi`azhîmi `inâyatillâhi wa karîmi nazharih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai engkau yang diistimewakan dengan inayah Allah yang agung dan pandangan-Nya yang mulia!
passages.en: Peace be upon you who are singled out by Allah's immense care and noble gaze!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا المَذْكُورَةُ بِخَيْرِ مَا ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ خِيرَتَهُ مِنْ بَشَرِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki ayyatuhal-madzkûratu bikhayri mâ dzakarallâhu bihi khîratahu min basyarih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai engkau yang disebut dengan sebaik-baik sebutan yang Allah berikan kepada insan pilihan-Nya!
passages.en: Peace be upon you who are spoken of in the finest way Allah speaks of His chosen among humanity!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا صَاحِبَةَ العَقْلِ الوَافِرِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ shâhibatal-`aqlil-wâfir.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai pemilik akal yang sempurna!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy and blessings of Allah, O the one of vast intellect!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا زَوْجَةَ النَّجْمِ الزَّاهِرِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ zawjatan-najmiz-zâhir.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai istri sang Bintang yang cemerlang!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy and blessings of Allah, O wife of the Shining Star!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا أَوَّلَ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَرَسُولِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ awwala man âmana billâhi wa rasûlihi Muhammad.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai orang pertama yang beriman kepada Allah dan Rasul-Nya, Muhammad!
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you who were the first to believe in Allah and His Messenger Muhammad!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مَنْ أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ السَّعْدَ لِكُلِّ مَنِ انْتَسَبَ إِلَيْهَا.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ man a`zhamallâhus-sa`da likulli man intasaba ilayhâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang melaluinya Allah menganugerahkan keberuntungan besar kepada setiap orang yang bernasab kepadanya!
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you, through whom Allah has granted immense fortune to all who carry a connection to you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مَنْ وَاصَلَ اللَّهُ عَظِيمَ هِبَاتِهِ وَتَفَضُّلَاتِهِ عَلَيْهَا.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ man wâshalallâhu `azhîma hibâtihi wa tafadhdhulâtihi `alayhâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang senantiasa Allah limpahi anugerah dan karunia-Nya yang agung!
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you whom Allah continuously lavishes His great gifts and favors!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا خَدِيجَةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidatanâ Khadîjah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy and blessings of Allah, O Sayyidatuna Khadijah!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ الزَّهْرَاءِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Ummaz-Zahrâ'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai ibunda az-Zahra!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, mother of az-Zahra!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ القَاسِمِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Ummal-Qâsim.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai ibunda al-Qasim!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, mother of al-Qasim!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الطَّيِّبِ الطَّاهِرِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Umma `Abdillâhith-Thayyibith-Thâhir.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai ibunda Abdullah, ath-Thayyib ath-Thahir!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, mother of Abdullah, at-Tayyib at-Tahir!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ زَيْنَبَ وَرُقَيَّةَ وَأُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Umma Zaynaba wa Ruqayyata wa Ummi Kultsûm.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai ibunda Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, mother of Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ العَالَمِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Umma Fâthimata sayyidati nisâ'il-`âlamîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai ibunda Fathimah, penghulu kaum wanita seluruh alam!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, mother of Fatimah, the leader of all women in creation!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا طَهَّرَكُمُ اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimâ thahharakumullâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, karena Allah telah menyucikan kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, for He has made you pure!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا اصْطَفَاكُمُ اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimash-thafâkumullâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, karena Allah telah memilih kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, for He has chosen you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا خَصَّصَكُمُ اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimâ khashshashakumullâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, karena Allah telah mengistimewakan kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, for He set you apart by distinctions reserved for you alone!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا اخْتَارَكُمُ المَوْلَى تَعَالَى فِي عُلَاهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimakh-târakumul-Maulâ ta`âlâ fî `ulâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, karena Tuhan Yang Maha Tinggi dalam keluhuran-Nya telah memilih kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, for the Exalted and Sublime Lord has selected you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا أَهْلَ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ ahla baytin-nubuwwah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai Ahlul Bait kenabian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, O household of prophethood!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مَعَادِنَ الفَضْلِ وَالفَخْرِ وَالعِزِّ وَالمَجْدِ وَالشَّرَفِ وَالفُتُوَّةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ ma`âdinal-fadhli wal-fakhri wal-`izzi wal-majdi wasy-syarafi wal-futuwwah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai sumber keutamaan, kebanggaan, kemuliaan, keagungan, kehormatan, dan keluhuran budi!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, O treasure-house of excellence, honor, glory, nobility, and all that is finest in a human being!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مَنْظُورَةً بِعَيْنِ العِنَايَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ manzhûratan bi`aynil-`inâyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang senantiasa dipandang dengan mata inayah!
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you who are always looked upon with the gaze of divine care!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مُتَبَوِّئَةً أَعْلَى مَنَازِلِ الوِلَايَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ mutabawwi'atan a`lâ manâzilil-wilâyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang menempati kedudukan kewalian tertinggi!
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you who occupy the highest stations of sainthood!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا خَدِيجَةَ، يَا بِنْتَ خُوَيْلِدٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidatanâ Khadîjah, yâ binta Khuwaylid.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah, wahai putri Khuwailid!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings, O Sayyidatuna Khadijah, O daughter of Khuwaylid!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا مَنْ قَالَ عَنْكِ سَيِّدُ الوُجُودِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (لَقَدْ آمَنَتْ بِي حِينَ كَفَرَ بِيَ النَّاسُ، وَصَدَّقَتْنِي حِينَ كَذَّبَنِيَ النَّاسُ، وَفَدَتْنِي بِنَفْسِهَا وَمَالِهَا، فَلَا -وَاللَّهِ- مَا أَبْدَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا).
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ man qâla `ankis-sayyidul-wujûdi shallallâhu `alayhi wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa sallam: Laqad âmanat bî hîna kafara biyan-nâs, wa shaddaqatnî hîna kadzdzabaniyan-nâs, wa fadatnî binafsihâ wa mâlihâ, falâ -wallâhi- mâ abdalaniyallâhu khayran minhâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai engkau yang tentangnya penghulu alam semesta ﷺ bersabda: "Sungguh ia beriman kepadaku ketika manusia mengingkariku, ia membenarkanku ketika manusia mendustakanku, dan ia mengorbankan jiwa serta hartanya untukku. Maka tidak — demi Allah — Allah tidak menggantikan untukku seorang pun yang lebih baik darinya."
passages.en: Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you about whom the master of existence (may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, his family, and his companions) said: "She believed in me when people disbelieved. She affirmed my truthfulness when people denied me. She spent her life and her wealth for me. So no — I swear by Allah, He has not given me anyone better in her place."

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا بَيْنَكِ وَبَيْنَ سَيِّدِ الوُجُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimâ baynaki wa bayna sayyidil-wujûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, demi ikatan antara dirimu dan penghulu alam semesta!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings by virtue of what is between you and the master of existence!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا بَيْنَكِ وَبَيْنَ صَاحِبِ المَقَامِ المَحْمُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimâ baynaki wa bayna shâhibil-maqâmil-mahmûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, demi ikatan antara dirimu dan pemilik al-Maqam al-Mahmud!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings by virtue of what is between you and the one who holds the Praiseworthy Station!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِاخْتِصَاصَاتِ اللَّهِ المَلِكِ العَلِيِّ لَكُمْ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bikh-tishâshâtillâhil-Malikil-`Aliyyi lakum.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, demi keistimewaan-keistimewaan yang Allah, Sang Raja Yang Maha Tinggi, khususkan bagi kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings by virtue of the unique favors Allah, the Sovereign Most High, has granted you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ بِمَا وَالَاكُمْ وَتَوَلَّاكُمْ، وَاصْطَفَاكُمْ وَأَعْلَاكُمْ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu bimâ wâlâkum wa tawallâkum, wash-thafâkum wa a`lâkum.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, demi kasih-Nya kepada kalian, perlindungan-Nya atas kalian, pemilihan-Nya terhadap kalian, dan pengangkatan derajat kalian!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings by virtue of His love for you, His guardianship of you, His choosing of you, and His raising of you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يَنْتَشِرُ شَذَا رَيَّاهُ فِي جَمِيعِ الوُجُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yantasyiru syadzâ rayyâhu fî jamî`il-wujûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang semerbak harumnya memenuhi seluruh alam!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace whose sweet fragrance fills all of existence!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يُدْرِكُ القَاصِدُ بِهِ غَايَةَ المَقْصُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yudrikul-qâshidu bihi ghâyatal-maqshûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya sang pencari mencapai puncak tujuan!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace by which the seeker reaches the ultimate goal!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا تَطْلُعُ لَنَا بِهِ شُمُوسُ السُّعُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman tathlu`u lanâ bihi syumûsus-su`ûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya matahari-matahari keberuntungan terbit bagi kami!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace through which the suns of good fortune rise upon us!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يُلْحِقُ اللَّهُ بِهِ بِالوَالِدِ المَوْلُودَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yulhiqullâhu bihi bil-wâlidil-maulûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya Allah mempertemukan sang anak dengan orang tuanya!
passages.en: Peace and Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you; peace through which Allah unites the child with the parent!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا نَدْخُلُ بِهِ مَدَاخِلَ خِيرَةِ الوُفُودِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman nadkhulu bihi madâkhila khîratil-wufûd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya kami masuk melalui pintu-pintu rombongan terbaik!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace that grants us entry into the best of gatherings!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يَعْظُمُ لَنَا بِهِ مِنْكُمُ القِرَى.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman ya`zhumu lanâ bihi minkumul-qirâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya jamuan kalian bagi kami semakin agung!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace through which your generous hospitality toward us is magnified!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا تَطِيبُ لَنَا بِهِ زِيَارَتُكُمْ فِي أُمِّ القُرَى.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman tathîbu lanâ bihi ziyâratukum fî Ummil-Qurâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya ziarah kami kepada kalian di Ummul Qura terasa nikmat!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace that sweetens our visit to you in Makkah, the Mother of Cities!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا عَمَّ نَفْعُهُ جَمِيعَ الوَرَى، وَيَخُصُّ مَنِ اتَّصَلَ بِنَا مِنْ وَالِدِينَ وَمَوْلُودِينَ، وَمَشَايِخَ وَمُتَعَلِّمِينَ، مِنْ حَاضِرِينَ وَغَائِبِينَ، وَمِنْ أَهْلِ البَرَازِخِ وَأَهْلِ الحَيَاةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman `amma naf`uhu jamî`al-warâ, wa yakhushshu man ittashala binâ min wâlidîna wa maulûdîn, wa masyâyikha wa muta`allimîn, min hâdhirîna wa ghâ'ibîn, wa min ahlil-barâzikhi wa ahlil-hayâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang manfaatnya merata bagi seluruh makhluk, dan terkhusus bagi mereka yang terhubung dengan kami: orang tua dan anak-anak, guru-guru dan para penuntut ilmu, yang hadir maupun yang jauh, penghuni alam barzakh maupun yang masih hidup!
passages.en: Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace whose benefits reach all of creation, and especially those connected to us: our parents, our children, our teachers, our students, those already in the realm of the grave and those still in this world!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ الَّذِي بِهِ فَضَّلَكِ اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidil-mursalînal-ladzî bihi fadhdhalakillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghulu para rasul, yang dengannya Allah mengutamakanmu!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the Master of the Messengers, through whom Allah favoured you!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى حَبِيبِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ الَّذِي بِهِ أَعْلَاكِ اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ habîbi rabbil-`âlamînal-ladzî bihi a`lâkillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kekasih Tuhan semesta alam, yang dengannya Allah meninggikan derajatmu!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the Beloved of the Lord of the worlds, through whom Allah raised you high!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى حَبِيبِ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَذْبَحُ الشَّاةَ فَيَقْسِمُهَا فِي صُوَيْحِبَاتِكِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ habîbir-Rahmânil-ladzî kâna yadzbahusy-syâta fayaqsimuhâ fî shuwayhibâtik.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kekasih Yang Maha Pengasih, yang dahulu menyembelih kambing lalu membagikannya kepada sahabat-sahabat dekatmu!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the Beloved of the Most Merciful, who would slaughter a sheep and distribute it among your dear friends!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَيِّدِ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ، وَأَكْرَمِهِمْ عَلَى رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidil-awwalîna wal-âkhirîn, wa akramihim `alâ rabbil-`âlamîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghulu generasi awal dan akhir, yang paling mulia di sisi Tuhan semesta alam!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the master of the first and the last, the most honored of all before the Lord of the worlds!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى ذُخْرِنَا وَفَخْرِنَا وَنُورِ قُلُوبِنَا وَحَيَاةِ أَرْوَاحِنَا بِنْتِكِ الزَّهْرَاءِ فَاطِمَةَ البَتُولِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ dzukhrinâ wa fakhrinâ wa nûri qulûbinâ wa hayâti arwâhinâ bintikiz-Zahrâ'i Fâthimatal-Batûl.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas simpanan kebanggaan kami, cahaya hati kami, dan kehidupan ruh kami: putrimu az-Zahra, Fathimah al-Batul!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our treasure and our pride, the light of our hearts and the life of our souls, your daughter az-Zahra, Fatimah al-Batul!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى زَوْجِهَا سَيْفِ اللَّهِ عَلِيِّ بنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ zawjihâ sayfillâhi `Aliyyi bni Abî Thâlib.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas suaminya, pedang Allah, Ali bin Abi Thalib!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon her husband, the Sword of Allah, Ali bin Abi Talib!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى الحَسَنِ وَالحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الجَنَّةِ فِي الجَنَّةِ، وَرَيْحَانَتَيْ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ بِنَصِّ السُّنَّةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alal-Hasani wal-Husayni sayyiday syabâbi ahlil-jannati fil-jannah, wa rayhânatay nabiyyillâhi binashshis-sunnah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas al-Hasan dan al-Husain, dua penghulu pemuda ahli surga di dalam surga, dan dua bunga kesayangan Nabi Allah menurut nash sunnah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the masters of the youth of Paradise, and the two sweet flowers of Allah's Prophet, as his own words make clear!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَادَتِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Abî Bakrin wa `Umara wa `Utsmân.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Abu Bakar, Umar, dan Utsman!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our masters Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jamî`i ummahâtil-mu'minîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh Ibunda kaum mukminin!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon all the Mothers of the Believers!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ ذُرِّيَّةِ فَاطِمَةَ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jamî`i dzurriyyati Fâthimata ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas segenap keturunan Fathimah seluruhnya!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon every descendant of Fatimah, one and all!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بنِ عَلَوِيِّ السَّقَافِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bni `Alawiyyis-Saqqâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Muhammad bin Alwi as-Saqqaf!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our master Muhammad bin Alawi as-Saqqaf!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَادَتِنَا آلِ أَبِي عَلَوِيٍّ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Âli Abî `Alawî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami keluarga Ba Alawi!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our masters, the Al Abi Alawi family!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ البَيْتِ النَّبَوِيِّ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahlil-baytin-nabawî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas segenap Ahlul Bait Nabi!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the entire household of the Prophet!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ المَعْلَاةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahlil-Ma`lâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas para penghuni pemakaman al-Ma'la!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the people of al-Ma'lah!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى مَشَايِخِنَا فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ masyâyikhinâ fî dînillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas guru-guru kami dalam agama Allah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our teachers in the religion of Allah!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى آبَائِنَا وَسَلَاسِلِ إِسْنَادِنَا الأَئِمَّةِ الهُدَاةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ âbâ'inâ wa salâsili isnâdinal-a'immatil-hudâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas leluhur kami serta rangkaian sanad kami, para imam pembawa petunjuk!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our forebears and our chains of transmission, the guiding Imams!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى مَنْ ضَمَّتْهُمُ المَقْبَرَةُ الشَّرِيفَةُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ man dhammat-humul-maqbaratusy-syarîfah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas semua yang dipeluk oleh pemakaman yang mulia ini!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon all those embraced by this noble cemetery!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الحَجُونِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahlil-Hajûn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghuni al-Hajun!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the people of al-Hajun!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الشُّبَيْكَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahlisy-Syubaykah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghuni asy-Syubaikah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the people of ash-Shubaykah!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الغَرْقَدِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahli Baqî`il-Gharqad.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghuni Baqi al-Gharqad!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the people of Baqi al-Gharqad!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَشَّارَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahli Basysyâr.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas penghuni Basysyar!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the people of Bashshar!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى فَخْرِ الوُجُودِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بنِ سَالِمٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ fakhril-wujûdi Abî Bakri bni Sâlim.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kebanggaan alam semesta, Syekh Abu Bakar bin Salim!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the pride of existence, Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَيِّدِنَا عُمَرَ بنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ العَطَّاسِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sayyidinâ `Umara bni `Abdir-Rahmânil-`Aththâs.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Umar bin Abdurrahman al-Atthas!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our master Umar bin Abdurrahman al-Attas!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أُصُولِهِمْ وَفُرُوعِهِمْ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ushûlihim wa furû`ihim.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas para leluhur serta keturunan mereka!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon their lineage and their progeny!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، فِي غَامِضِ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ jamî`i auliyâ'illâhi, fî ghâmidhi `ilmillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh wali Allah yang tersembunyi dalam ilmu Allah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon every friend of Allah whom only He knows!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَادَتِنَا جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ وَعِزْرَائِيلَ، وَمُنْكِرٍ وَنَكِيرٍ، وَرَقِيبٍ وَعَتِيدٍ، وَمَالِكٍ وَرِضْوَانَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Jibrâ'îla wa Mîkâ'îla wa Isrâfîla wa `Izrâ'îl, wa Munkirin wa Nakîr, wa Raqîbin wa `Atîd, wa Mâlikin wa Ridhwân.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Jibril, Mikail, Israfil, Izrail, Munkar, Nakir, Raqib, Atid, Malik, dan Ridwan!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our masters Jibril, Mikail, Israfil, Azrail, Munkar, Nakir, Raqib, Atid, Malik, and Ridwan!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى المَلَائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alal-malâ'ikatil-muqarrabîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas para malaikat muqarrabin!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the angels brought near!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَادَتِنَا آدَمَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَنُوحٍ وَهُودٍ وَصَالِحٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى، وَمَنْ بَيْنَهُمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâdatinâ Âdama wa Idrîsa wa Nûhin wa Hûdin wa Shâlihin wa Ibrâhîma wa Mûsâ wa `Îsâ, wa man baynahum minan-nabiyyîna wal-mursalîn, shalawâtullâhi wa salâmuhu `alayhim ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas junjungan kami Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Shalih, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, serta para nabi dan rasul di antara mereka. Shalawat dan salam Allah atas mereka semua!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon our masters Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, and all the prophets and messengers between them. May Allah's blessings and peace be upon every one of them!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى قُطْبِ زَمَانِنَا، وَكُلِّ قُطْبٍ مَرَّ فِي الأَزْمَانِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ quthbi zamâninâ, wa kulli quthbin marra fil-azmân.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas quthub zaman kita serta setiap quthub yang pernah ada sepanjang masa!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the spiritual pole of our time, and upon every spiritual pole through the ages!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى الإِمَامِ المَهْدِيِّ المُنْتَظَرِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alal-Imâmil-Mahdiyyil-muntazhar.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas Imam Mahdi yang dinanti!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the awaited Imam al-Mahdi!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ النُّصْرَةِ لِشَرْعِ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ahlin-nushrati lisyar`illâhi subhânahu wa ta`âlâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas para pembela syariat Allah Yang Maha Suci lagi Maha Tinggi!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon those who champion the sacred law of Allah, glorified and exalted is He!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَئِمَّةِ دِينِ اللَّهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ a'immati dînillâhi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh imam agama Allah!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon the Imams of Allah's religion, all of them!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alal-mu'minîna wal-mu'minât, wal-muslimîna wal-muslimât.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas kaum mukminin dan mukminat, muslimin dan muslimat!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon every believing man and believing woman, every Muslim man and Muslim woman!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، أَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ، غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ، وَإِنَّا -إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ- بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ العَافِيَةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum dâra qaumin mu'minîn, atâkum mâ tû`adûn, ghadan mu'ajjalûn, wa innâ -insyâ Allâhu- bikum lâhiqûn, wa yarhamullâhul-mustaqdimîna minkum wal-musta'khirîn, nas'alullâha lanâ wa lakumul-`âfiyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai penghuni negeri kaum beriman! Telah datang kepada kalian apa yang dijanjikan; esok hanyalah waktu yang ditangguhkan, dan kami — insya Allah — akan menyusul kalian. Semoga Allah merahmati mereka yang mendahului di antara kalian dan yang datang kemudian. Kami memohon kepada Allah keselamatan bagi kami dan bagi kalian.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O abode of believers! What you were promised has come to you, and indeed, Allah willing, we will join you. May Allah have mercy on those who went ahead of us, and on those who will follow. We ask Allah for safety and wellbeing for us and for you.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، مِنْ أَهْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ؛ كَيْفَ وَجَدْتُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ؟
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ ahla lâ ilâha illallâh, min ahli lâ ilâha illallâh; kayfa wajadtum lâ ilâha illallâh?
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai ahli la ilaha illallah, dari ahli la ilaha illallah: bagaimana kalian mendapati la ilaha illallah?
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O people of la ilaha illallah, from the people of la ilaha illallah. How have you found the testimony of la ilaha illallah?

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ كُنْ لَنَا وَلِمَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) bihaqqi lâ ilâha illallâh, kun lanâ wa liman qâla: lâ ilâha illallâh.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) demi kebenaran la ilaha illallah, jadilah Penolong bagi kami dan bagi siapa saja yang mengucapkan: la ilaha illallah.
passages.en: O Allah, by the right of la ilaha illallah, be with us and with those who say la ilaha illallah.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) رَبَّ الأَرْوَاحِ البَاقِيَةِ، وَالأَجْسَامِ البَالِيَةِ الَّتِي خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ بِكَ مُؤْمِنَةٌ، أَدْخِلِ (اللَّهُمَّ) عَلَيْهِمْ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ رَوْحًا مِنْكَ، وَسَلَامًا مِنَّا.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) rabbal-arwâhil-bâqiyati, wal-ajsâmil-bâliyatil-latî kharajat minad-dunyâ wa hiya bika mu'minah, adkhilillâhumma `alayhim fî qubûrihim rauhan minka, wa salâman minnâ.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) Tuhan segala ruh yang kekal dan jasad-jasad yang telah hancur, yang meninggalkan dunia dalam keadaan beriman kepada-Mu — masukkanlah, ya Allah, kepada mereka di dalam kubur mereka ketenteraman dari-Mu dan salam dari kami.
passages.en: O Allah, Lord of souls that endure and bodies that perish, send upon them in their graves a gentle breeze from You and peace from us.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ فِي كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ وَنَفَسٍ. عَدَدَ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu fî kulli lamhatin wa nafas, `adada khalqillâhi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, pada setiap kejapan mata dan hembusan napas — sejumlah ciptaan Allah, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, in every instant and every breath — by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: كُلُّ سَلَامٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يُفَرِّجُ اللَّهُ بِهِ كُرُوبَ الأُمَّةِ، وَيَكْشِفُ الغُمَّةَ، وَيَجْلُو بِهِ الظُّلْمَةَ، وَيَدْفَعُ بِهِ النِّقْمَةَ، وَيَبْسُطُ بِهِ بِسَاطَ النِّعْمَةِ، وَيُدْخِلُنَا فِي دَوَائِرِ خَوَاصِّ الأَئِمَّةِ.
passages.tr: Kullu salâmin min dzâlika yufarrijullâhu bihi kurûbal-ummati, wa yaksyiful-ghummata, wa yajlû bihizh-zhulmata, wa yadfa`u bihin-niqmata, wa yabsuthu bihi bisâthan-ni`mati, wa yudkhilunâ fî dawâ'iri khawâshshil-a'immah.
passages.id_: Dengan setiap salam itu, semoga Allah melapangkan kesulitan umat, menyingkapkan kesusahan, menerangi kegelapan, menolak murka, membentangkan hamparan nikmat, dan memasukkan kami ke dalam lingkaran para imam pilihan.
passages.en: With each greeting of peace, may Allah alleviate the distress of the ummah, remove its sorrow, dispel the darkness, avert His wrath, spread blessings, and admit us into the circles of the elite Imams.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يَصْحَبُنَا بِهِ لُطْفُ اللَّهِ الخَفِيُّ فِي كُلِّ مُهِمَّةٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yash-habunâ bihi luthfullâhil-khafiyyu fî kulli muhimmah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya kelembutan Allah yang tersembunyi menyertai kami dalam setiap urusan penting!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace through which Allah's gentle care accompanies us in everything that concerns us!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا نُرْفَعُ بِهِ فِي تَقْوَى المُهَيْمِنِ وَانْكِسَارِ القَلْبِ مِنْ أَجْلِهِ وَالتَّذَلُّلِ لَهُ أَعْلَى قِمَّةٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman nurfa`u bihi fî taqwal-Muhaymini wankisâril-qalbi min ajlihi wat-tadzalluli lahu a`lâ qimmah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya kami diangkat ke puncak tertinggi ketakwaan kepada Yang Maha Memelihara, dengan hati yang hancur karena-Nya dan kerendahan diri di hadapan-Nya!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace that carries us to the highest peaks of mindfulness of Allah, with heart broken open before Him in the most beautiful of humble surrender!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يُصْلِحُ اللَّهُ بِهِ شُؤُونَ المُسْلِمِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yushlihullâhu bihi syu'ûnal-muslimîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya Allah memperbaiki urusan kaum muslimin!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace through which Allah sets right the affairs of the Muslims!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا يُدْفَعُ بِهِ عَنَّا الآفَاتُ وَعَنْ جَمِيعِ المُؤْمِنِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman yudfa`u bihi `annal-âfâtu wa `an jamî`il-mu'minîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya segala bencana ditolak dari kami dan dari seluruh kaum mukminin!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace through which all calamities are warded off from us and from every believer!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ سَلَامًا نَدْخُلُ بِهِ فِي حِصْنِ اللَّهِ الحَصِينِ، وَفِي حِرْزِهِ المَتِينِ، مِنْ شُرُورِ الخَلَائِقِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu salâman nadkhulu bihi fî hishnillâhil-hashîn, wa fî hirzihil-matîn, min syurûril-khalâ'iqi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — salam yang dengannya kami masuk ke dalam benteng Allah yang kokoh dan perlindungan-Nya yang kuat, dari kejahatan seluruh makhluk!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings; peace that brings us inside Allah's impregnable fortress and His secure protection, safe from the evil of all that exists!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا كِرَامُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَوْفِيَاءُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَتْقِيَاءُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَصْفِيَاءُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا مَنِ اصْطَفَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَاجْتَبَى.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ kirâm. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ aufiyâ'. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ atqiyâ'. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ ashfiyâ'. As-salâmu `alaykum yâ manish-thafâhumullâhu wajtabâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai orang-orang mulia! Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai orang-orang setia! Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai orang-orang bertakwa! Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai orang-orang suci! Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai mereka yang Allah pilih dan istimewakan!
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O honorable ones! Peace be upon you, O loyal ones! Peace be upon you, O pious ones! Peace be upon you, O pure ones! Peace be upon you whom Allah has chosen and preferred!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَدَدَ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ. عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، عَدَدَ مَا فِي الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ. عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَمِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا. عَدَدَ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu `adada khalqillâhi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtihi mitsla dzâlika kullih. `Adada mâ khalaqa, wa mil'a mâ khalaqa, `adada mâ fil-ardhi was-samâ'. `Adada kulli syay'in, wa mil'a kulli syay'in, fî kulli lahzhatin abadâ. `Adada khalqillâhi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya — sejumlah ciptaan Allah, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya, dan sebanding itu semua; sejumlah apa yang Ia ciptakan dan sepenuh apa yang Ia ciptakan; sejumlah apa yang ada di bumi dan di langit; sejumlah segala sesuatu dan sepenuh segala sesuatu, pada setiap saat untuk selamanya; sejumlah ciptaan Allah, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words, equivalent to all of that; by the number of all He created, and what fills what He created, and the number of everything on earth and in the heavens; by the number of all things, and the fullness of all things, in every instant forever; by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: كُنْتِ أَهْلَ المَعْرُوفِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ فِي الخَبَرِ: (أَهْلُ المَعْرُوفِ فِي الدُّنْيَا هُمْ أَهْلُ المَعْرُوفِ فِي الآخِرَةِ).
passages.tr: Kunti ahlal-ma`rûfi fid-dunyâ, wa laqad jâ'a fil-khabar: Ahlul-ma`rûfi fid-dunyâ hum ahlul-ma`rûfi fil-âkhirah.
passages.id_: Engkau adalah ahli kebajikan di dunia, dan sungguh telah datang dalam riwayat: "Ahli kebajikan di dunia adalah ahli kebajikan di akhirat."
passages.en: You were of those who gave freely and beautifully in this world. And it has been reported that: "Those who gave in this world are those who shall receive in the Hereafter."

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: فَيَا أَهْلَ المَعْرُوفِ، قَدْ وَصَلَ الضُّيُوفُ، يَرْجُونَ عَطَاءَكُمُ المَأْلُوفَ.
passages.tr: Fayâ ahlal-ma`rûfi, qad washaladh-dhuyûfu, yarjûna `athâ'akumul-ma'lûf.
passages.id_: Maka wahai ahli kebajikan, para tamu telah tiba, mengharapkan pemberian kalian yang sudah dikenal.
passages.en: So, O people of kindness, your guests have arrived, hoping for the generosity they have always known from you.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: فَنَظَرُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ النَّظَرِ، رِعَايَتُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الرِّعَايَةِ، مَوَائِدُكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الكَرَمِ، وَبِسَاطُ جُودِكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الجُودِ.
passages.tr: Fanazharukum yâ ahlan-nazhari, ri`âyatukum yâ ahlar-ri`âyati, mawâ'idukum yâ ahlal-karami, wa bisâthu jûdikum yâ ahlal-jûd.
passages.id_: Pandangan kalian, wahai pemilik pandangan! Pemeliharaan kalian, wahai ahli pemeliharaan! Hidangan kalian, wahai ahli kemurahan! Dan hamparan kedermawanan kalian, wahai ahli kedermawanan!
passages.en: Cast your gaze upon us, O people whose gaze is a gift! Extend your care to us, O people of guardianship! Lay out your tables for us, O people of generosity! Your abundance, O people who have never stopped giving!

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: عَلَيْكُمْ صَلَوَاتُ رَبِّنَا وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ وَنَفَسٍ. عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: `Alaykum shalawâtu rabbinâ wa rahmatuhu fî kulli lamhatin wa nafas, `adada khalqihi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Atas kalian shalawat Tuhan kami dan rahmat-Nya pada setiap kejapan mata dan hembusan napas — sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Upon you be the blessings of our Lord and His mercy in every instant and every breath, by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى سَائِرِ المُتَعَلِّقِينَ بِكُمْ، وَالمُنْطَوِينَ فِيكُمْ، وَالدَّاخِلِينَ فِي حِمَاكُمْ. عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُ اللَّهِ، وَمَا وَسِعَهُ عِلْمُ اللَّهِ فِي كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ وَنَفَسٍ. عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ sâ'iril-muta`alliqîna bikum, wal-munthawîna fîkum, wad-dâkhilîna fî himâkum. `Adada mâ ahâtha bihi `ilmullâhi, wa mâ wasi`ahu `ilmullâhi fî kulli lamhatin wa nafas. `Adada khalqihi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas semua yang bertalian dengan kalian, yang bernaung pada kalian, dan yang masuk dalam perlindungan kalian — sejumlah apa yang diliputi ilmu Allah dan seluas apa yang dicakup ilmu Allah, pada setiap kejapan mata dan hembusan napas; sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings, and upon everyone who clings to you, is enveloped by your presence, and has stepped under the wing of your protection — by the number of what is encompassed in Allah's knowledge, and equal to what fills the depth of what He knows, in every instant and every breath, by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ﴿إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ﴾
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. Innâ a`thaynâkal-kautsar, fashalli lirabbika wanhar, inna syâni'aka huwal-abtar.
passages.id_: Surah al-Kautsar: "Sesungguhnya Kami telah memberimu al-Kautsar; maka shalatlah untuk Tuhanmu dan berkurbanlah; sesungguhnya orang yang membencimu, dialah yang terputus."
passages.en: Surah al-Kawthar: "Truly We have granted you al-Kawthar; so pray to your Lord and sacrifice; truly it is your enemy who is cut off."

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ ۝ لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ۝ وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ ۝ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ۝ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ﴾
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. Qul yâ ayyuhal-kâfirûn, lâ a`budu mâ ta`budûn, wa lâ antum `âbidûna mâ a`bud, wa lâ ana `âbidun mâ `abadtum, wa lâ antum `âbidûna mâ a`bud, lakum dînukum wa liya dîn.
passages.id_: Surah al-Kafirun: "Katakanlah: Wahai orang-orang kafir, aku tidak menyembah apa yang kalian sembah, dan kalian bukan penyembah apa yang aku sembah; aku tidak akan menyembah apa yang kalian sembah, dan kalian tidak akan menyembah apa yang aku sembah. Bagimu agamamu, dan bagiku agamaku."
passages.en: Surah al-Kafirun: "Say: O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship; nor shall I worship what you have worshipped, nor will you worship what I worship. To you your religion, and to me mine."

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ﴿إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ ۝ وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا ۝ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًا﴾
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. Idzâ jâ'a nashrullâhi wal-fath, wa ra'aytan-nâsa yadkhulûna fî dînillâhi afwâjâ, fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirhu innahu kâna tawwâbâ.
passages.id_: Surah an-Nashr: "Apabila telah datang pertolongan Allah dan kemenangan, dan engkau melihat manusia berbondong-bondong masuk agama Allah, maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan mohonlah ampunan kepada-Nya; sesungguhnya Dia Maha Penerima tobat."
passages.en: Surah an-Nasr: "When Allah's help and the victory come, and you see the people entering Allah's religion in throngs, then glorify your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness; truly He is ever-relenting."

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: سُورَةُ الإِخْلَاصِ (١١ مَرَّةً). المُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ (مَرَّةً مَرَّةً). سُورَةُ الفَاتِحَةِ (مَرَّةً).
passages.tr: Sûratul-Ikhlâsh (11x). Al-Mu`awwidzatayn (marratan marratan). Sûratul-Fâtihah (marrah).
passages.id_: Surah al-Ikhlas (11 kali); al-Mu'awwidzatain (masing-masing sekali); Surah al-Fatihah (sekali).
passages.en: Surah al-Ikhlas (11 times); Surah al-Falaq and Surah an-Nas (once each); Surah al-Fatihah (once).

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ (١٥ مَرَّةً). فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: Subhânallâhi wa bihamdih (15x). Fî kulli lahzhatin abadan `adada khalqihi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Maha Suci Allah dan dengan memuji-Nya (15 kali) — pada setiap saat untuk selamanya, sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Glory belongs to Allah with His praise (15 times) — at every instant in time forever, by the number of His creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٤ مَرَّاتٍ). وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ. فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: Subhânallâhi, wal-hamdu lillâhi, wa lâ ilâha illallâhu, wallâhu akbar (4x). Wa lâ haula wa lâ quwwata illâ billâhil-`Aliyyil-`Azhîm. Fî kulli lahzhatin abadan `adada khalqihi wa ridhâ'a nafsihi wa zinata `arsyihi wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Maha Suci Allah, segala puji bagi Allah, tiada tuhan selain Allah, dan Allah Maha Besar (4 kali). Dan tiada daya serta kekuatan kecuali dengan pertolongan Allah Yang Maha Tinggi lagi Maha Agung — pada setiap saat untuk selamanya, sejumlah ciptaan-Nya, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest (4 times). And there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Great — at every instant in time forever, by the number of His creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink it would take to write His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) صَلِّ عَلَى حَبِيبِكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ (٣ مَرَّاتٍ).
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) shalli `alâ habîbika sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa sallim (3x).
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada kekasih-Mu, junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau (3 kali).
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers upon Your beloved, our master Muhammad, his Family, and his Companions, and grant them peace (3 times).

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: تَقَبَّلِ (اللَّهُمَّ) مِنَّا ذَلِكَ بِمَحْضِ فَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَمَنِّكَ إِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَنُوحٍ وَهُودٍ وَصَالِحٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى، وَجَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَسَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ بِنْتِ خُوَيْلِدٍ صَاحِبَةِ المَقَامِ، وَسَيِّدِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ، وَالحَسَنِ وَالحُسَيْنِ وَفَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ، وَعَائِشَةَ الرِّضَى وَالحَمْزَةَ وَالعَبَّاسِ، وَإِلَى أَرْوَاحِ سَادَاتِنَا القَاسِمِ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ الطَّيِّبِ، وَسَيِّدَاتِنَا فَاطِمَةَ وَزَيْنَبَ وَرُقَيَّةَ وَأُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بَنَاتِ سَيِّدِ الوُجُودِ.
passages.tr: Taqabbalillâhumma minnâ dzâlika bimahdhi fadhlika wa jûdika wa mannika ilâ rûhi sayyidinâ rasûlillâhi Muhammadi bni `Abdillâhi shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam, wa sayyidinâ Âdama wa Idrîsa wa Nûhin wa Hûdin wa Shâlihin wa Ibrâhîma wa Mûsâ wa `Îsâ, wa jamî`in-nabiyyîna wal-mursalîn, wa sayyidatinâ Khadîjata binti Khuwaylidin shâhibatil-maqâm, wa sayyidinâ Abî Bakrin wa `Umara wa `Utsmâna wa `Aliyyin, wal-Hasani wal-Husayni wa Fâthimataz-Zahrâ', wa `Â'isyatar-ridhâ wal-Hamzata wal-`Abbâs, wa ilâ arwâhi sâdâtinal-Qâsimi wa `Abdillâhith-Thayyib, wa sayyidâtinâ Fâthimata wa Zaynaba wa Ruqayyata wa Ummi Kultsûmin banâti sayyidil-wujûd.
passages.id_: Terimalah itu dari kami, ya Allah, dengan murni karunia, kedermawanan, dan anugerah-Mu. Sampaikanlah pahalanya kepada ruh junjungan kami Rasulullah Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ; junjungan kami Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Shalih, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, dan seluruh nabi dan rasul; junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah binti Khuwailid, pemilik maqam ini; junjungan kami Abu Bakar, Umar, Utsman, Ali, al-Hasan, al-Husain, Fathimah az-Zahra, Aisyah yang diridhai, Hamzah, dan al-Abbas; serta kepada arwah junjungan kami al-Qasim dan Abdullah ath-Thayyib, dan junjungan kami Fathimah, Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum, putri-putri penghulu alam semesta.
passages.en: Accept this from us, O Allah, by Your sheer grace, generosity, and favor. Convey its reward to the soul of our master, the Messenger of Allah, Muhammad bin Abdullah, peace and blessings be upon him, and our masters Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, and all the Prophets and Messengers. And to Sayyidatuna Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, in whose presence we are. And to our masters Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Fatimah az-Zahra, A'ishah ar-Ridha, Hamzah, and al-Abbas, and to the souls of our noble masters al-Qasim and Abdullah at-Tayyib, and Sayyidatuna Fatimah, Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum, the daughters of the master of existence.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَإِلَى أَرْوَاحِ جَمِيعِ المُتَعَلِّقِينَ بِهِمْ، وَالمُنْتَمِينَ لَهُمْ، وَأَهْلِ مَحَبَّتِهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ arwâhi jamî`il-muta`alliqîna bihim, wal-muntamîna lahum, wa ahli mahabbatihim ajma`în.
passages.id_: Dan kepada arwah semua yang bertalian dengan mereka, yang bernasab kepada mereka, dan segenap pecinta mereka.
passages.en: And to the souls of everyone connected to them, everyone who belongs to them, and everyone who loves them.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَإِلَى أَرْوَاحِ جَمِيعِ المُنْتَسِبِينَ إِلَى سَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ، وَالمُتَعَلِّقِينَ بِهَا، وَأَهْلِ مَقْبَرَتِهَا أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ arwâhi jamî`il-muntasibîna ilâ sayyidatinâ Khadîjata, wal-muta`alliqîna bihâ, wa ahli maqbaratihâ ajma`în.
passages.id_: Dan kepada arwah semua yang bernasab kepada junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah, yang bertalian dengannya, dan seluruh penghuni pemakamannya.
passages.en: And to the souls of all who are affiliated with Sayyidatuna Khadijah, those connected to her, and all the people of her resting place.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَإِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا المُهَاجِرِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَحْمَدَ بنِ عِيسَى وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بنِ أَحْمَدَ وَإِخْوَانِهِ، وَأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الغَرْقَدِ، وَأَهْلِ الحَجُونِ وَالشُّبَيْكَةِ وَالمَعْلَاةِ، وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِ المَقْدِسِ، وَجَمِيعِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ فِي غَامِضِ عِلْمِكَ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ rûhi sayyidinal-Muhâjiri ilallâhi Ahmada bni `Îsâ wa `Ubaydillâhi bni Ahmada wa ikhwânih, wa ahli Baqî`il-Gharqad, wa ahlil-Hajûni wasy-Syubaykati wal-Ma`lâh, wa ahli Baytil-Maqdis, wa jamî`i auliyâ'ika fî ghâmidhi `ilmik.
passages.id_: Dan kepada ruh junjungan kami al-Muhajir ilallah Ahmad bin Isa, Ubaidillah bin Ahmad beserta saudara-saudaranya; penghuni Baqi al-Gharqad; penghuni al-Hajun, asy-Syubaikah, dan al-Ma'la; penghuni Baitul Maqdis; serta seluruh wali-Mu yang tersembunyi dalam ilmu-Mu.
passages.en: And to the soul of our master, al-Muhajir ilAllah Ahmad bin Isa, and Ubaydullah bin Ahmad, and his brothers, and the people of Baqi al-Gharqad, and the people of al-Hajun, ash-Shubaykah, and al-Ma'lah, and the people of Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem), and every last one of Your saints whom only You know.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَأَئِمَّةِ دِينِكَ الإِمَامِ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، وَالإِمَامِ مَالِكِ ابنِ أَنَسٍ، وَالإِمَامِ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ إِدْرِيسَ الشَّافِعِيِّ وَالإِمَامِ أَحْمَدَ ابنِ حَنْبَلَ.
passages.tr: Wa a'immati dînikal-Imâmi Abî Hanîfata, wal-Imâmi Mâliki bni Anas, wal-Imâmi Muhammadi bni Idrîsasy-Syâfi`iyyi wal-Imâmi Ahmada bni Hanbal.
passages.id_: Dan para imam agama-Mu: Imam Abu Hanifah, Imam Malik bin Anas, Imam Muhammad bin Idris asy-Syafi'i, dan Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal.
passages.en: And the Imams of Your religion: Imam Abu Hanifah, Imam Malik ibn Anas, Imam Muhammad bin Idris ash-Shafi'i, and Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَالإِمَامِ أَحْمَدَ البَدَوِيِّ، وَالإِمَامِ الرِّفَاعِيِّ، وَالإِمَامِ عَبْدِ القَادِرِ الجِيلَانِيِّ، وَالإِمَامِ أَبِي الحَسَنِ الشَّاذِلِيِّ، وَالإِمَامِ شُعَيْبٍ أَبِي مَدْيَنَ المَغْرِبِيِّ، وَالإِمَامِ عَبْدِ العَزِيزِ الدَّبَّاغِ، وَأُصُولِهِمْ، وَجَمِيعِ صَالِحِي عِبَادِكَ.
passages.tr: Wal-Imâmi Ahmadal-Badawiyyi, wal-Imâmir-Rifâ`iyyi, wal-Imâmi `Abdil-Qâdiril-Jîlâniyyi, wal-Imâmi Abil-Hasanisy-Syâdziliyyi, wal-Imâmi Syu`aybin Abî Madyanal-Maghribiyyi, wal-Imâmi `Abdil-`Azîzid-Dabbâgh, wa ushûlihim, wa jamî`i shâlihî `ibâdik.
passages.id_: Dan Imam Ahmad al-Badawi, Imam ar-Rifa'i, Imam Abdul Qadir al-Jailani, Imam Abul Hasan asy-Syadzili, Imam Syu'aib Abu Madyan al-Maghribi, Imam Abdul Aziz ad-Dabbagh, para leluhur mereka, dan seluruh hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh.
passages.en: And Imam Ahmad al-Badawi, Imam ar-Rifa'i, Imam Abdul Qadir al-Jilani, Imam Abul Hasan ash-Shadhili, Imam Shu'ayb Abu Madyan al-Maghribi, Imam Abdul Aziz ad-Dabbagh, and their forebears, and every righteous servant of Yours.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَإِلَى رُوحِ وَالِدِينَا وَذَوِي الحُقُوقِ عَلَيْنَا وَمَوْتَى الحَاضِرِينَ خَاصَّةً، وَأَمْوَاتِنَا وَأَمْوَاتِ المُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ تَغَشَّاهُمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ، وَأَرْوَاحُنَا مَعَهُمْ وَفِيهِمْ، وَبِهِمْ عَلَيْكَ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ rûhi wâlidînâ wa dzawil-huqûqi `alaynâ wa mautal-hâdhirîna khâsshah, wa amwâtinâ wa amwâtil-muslimîna ilâ yaumil-qiyâmati taghasysyâhum bir-rahmah, wa arwâhunâ ma`ahum wa fîhim, wa bihim `alayk.
passages.id_: Dan kepada ruh kedua orang tua kami, mereka yang memiliki hak atas kami, khususnya orang-orang yang telah wafat dari para hadirin, orang-orang kami yang telah wafat, dan seluruh muslimin yang wafat hingga hari kiamat. Liputilah mereka dengan rahmat, dan semoga ruh kami bersama dan di tengah mereka. Dan melalui mereka kami memohon kepada-Mu.
passages.en: And to the souls of our parents and those who have rights over us, and especially the deceased of those present, and our own departed, and every departed Muslim until the Day of Resurrection. Envelop them in mercy, may our souls be with them and among them. And through them we ask You.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: اجْعَلْهَا سَاعَةً مِنْ أَبْرَكِ السَّاعَاتِ عَلَيْنَا، وَعَلَى الأُمَّةِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Ij`alhâ sâ`atan min abrakis-sâ`âti `alaynâ, wa `alal-ummati ajma`în.
passages.id_: Jadikanlah saat ini termasuk saat yang paling berkah bagi kami dan bagi seluruh umat.
passages.en: Make this moment among the most blessed moments for us and for the entire Ummah.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَبِوَجَاهَةِ سَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ وَمَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهَا وَبِسَلَامِكَ عَلَيْهَا، انْشُرْ لَنَا رَايَاتِ السَّلَامِ، وَحَقِّقْنَا بِحَقَائِقِ الإِسْلَامِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالإِحْسَانِ، وَارْفَعْنَا إِلَى أَعْلَى مَرَاتِبِ الإِيقَانِ وَالعِرْفَانِ، فَضْلًا وَمَنًّا وَجُودًا وَكَرَمًا.
passages.tr: Wa biwajâhati sayyidatinâ Khadîjata wa mâ baynaka wa baynahâ wa bisalâmika `alayhâ, unsyur lanâ râyâtis-salâm, wa haqqiqnâ bihaqâ'iqil-islâmi wal-îmâni wal-ihsân, warfa`nâ ilâ a`lâ marâtibil-îqâni wal-`irfân, fadhlan wa mannan wa jûdan wa karamâ.
passages.id_: Demi kedudukan junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah, demi ikatan antara Engkau dan dirinya, dan demi salam-Mu kepadanya, kibarkanlah bagi kami panji-panji keselamatan; wujudkanlah pada kami hakikat Islam, iman, dan ihsan; dan angkatlah kami ke derajat keyakinan dan makrifat tertinggi — semata karena karunia, anugerah, kedermawanan, dan kemurahan-Mu.
passages.en: By the honor of Sayyidatuna Khadijah and what is between You and her, and by Your greetings of peace to her, spread the banners of peace for us. Enable us to actualize the realities of Islam, faith, and spiritual excellence. Raise us to the highest levels of certainty and gnosis, all by Your grace and generosity.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَأَكْرِمْنَا إِذَا وَفَدْنَا عَلَيْهَا بِنَقَاءِ قُلُوبِنَا عَنْ جَمِيعِ الشَّوَائِبِ، وَارْفَعْنَا إِلَى أَعْلَى المَرَاتِبِ، وَنَيْلِ غَايَاتِ المَطَالِبِ، وَفَوْقَ المَطَالِبِ وَالمَآرِبِ، مِنْ خَيْرَاتِكَ، وَعَظِيمِ هِبَاتِكَ، وَجَزِيلِ عَطِيَّاتِكَ، فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالبَرْزَخِ وَالآخِرَةِ، مَعَ دَفْعِ المَشَاغِبِ وَالمَتَاعِبِ وَالمَصَاعِبِ.
passages.tr: Wa akrimnâ idzâ wafadnâ `alayhâ binaqâ'i qulûbinâ `an jamî`isy-syawâ'ib, warfa`nâ ilâ a`lal-marâtib, wa nayli ghâyâtil-mathâlib, wa fauqal-mathâlibi wal-ma'ârib, min khayrâtika, wa `azhîmi hibâtika, wa jazîli `athiyyâtika, fid-dunyâ wal-barzakhi wal-âkhirah, ma`a daf`il-masyâghibi wal-matâ`ibi wal-mashâ`ib.
passages.id_: Muliakanlah kami, saat kami berkunjung kepadanya, dengan hati yang bersih dari segala noda. Angkatlah kami ke derajat tertinggi, dan sampaikanlah kami pada puncak segala permohonan — bahkan melampaui permohonan dan keinginan — dari kebaikan-Mu, anugerah-Mu yang agung, dan pemberian-Mu yang melimpah, di dunia, alam barzakh, dan akhirat, seraya menolak segala gangguan, kepayahan, dan kesulitan.
passages.en: Honor us, as we have visited her, by purifying our hearts of every impurity. Elevate us to the highest ranks, and let us attain our utmost requests and more than we could ever imagine of Your goodness, great gifts and generous blessings, in this world, the life of the grave, and the hereafter, while repelling all disturbances, hardships, and adversities.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا نَظَرَ رَحْمَةٍ، وَابْسُطْ لَنَا بِسَاطَ النِّعْمَةِ، وَادْفَعْ عَنَّا كُلَّ نِقْمَةٍ.
passages.tr: Wanzhur ilaynâ nazhara rahmah, wabsuth lanâ bisâthan-ni`mah, wadfa` `annâ kulla niqmah.
passages.id_: Pandanglah kami dengan pandangan rahmat, bentangkanlah bagi kami hamparan nikmat, dan tolaklah dari kami segala murka.
passages.en: Look upon us with mercy, spread the carpet of blessings for us, and repel from us all wrath.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَكُنْ لَنَا فِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ بِمَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ، وَعَامِلْنَا فِي الأَحْوَالِ كُلِّهَا وَفِي جَمِيعِ سَاعَاتِنَا بِمَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ، وَعَامِلْنَا بِالفَضْلِ وَبِمَحْضِ الفَضْلِ وَالجُودِ وَالامْتِنَانِ، يَا كَرِيمُ يَا مَنَّانُ، وَرَقِّنَا إِلَى أَعْلَى مَرَاتِبِ القُرْبِ مِنْكَ مَعَ مَنِ اخْتَصَصْتَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ أَهْلِ وُدِّكَ، وَأَهْلِ مَحَبَّتِكَ وَأَهْلِ الدُّنُوِّ إِلَى حَضْرَتِكَ، فَضْلًا مِنْكَ وَجُودًا وَكَرَمًا.
passages.tr: Wa kun lanâ fî hâdzihis-sâ`ati bimâ anta ahluh, wa `âmilnâ fil-ahwâli kullihâ wa fî jamî`i sâ`âtinâ bimâ anta ahluh, wa `âmilnâ bil-fadhli wa bimahdhil-fadhli wal-jûdi wal-imtinân, yâ Karîmu yâ Mannân, wa raqqinâ ilâ a`lâ marâtibil-qurbi minka ma`a man ikhtashashta min `ibâdika ahli wuddika, wa ahli mahabbatika wa ahlid-dunuwwi ilâ hadhratika, fadhlan minka wa jûdan wa karamâ.
passages.id_: Jadilah bagi kami pada saat ini sebagaimana yang layak bagi-Mu; perlakukanlah kami dalam segala keadaan dan di seluruh waktu kami sebagaimana yang layak bagi-Mu; dan perlakukanlah kami dengan karunia — dengan murni karunia, kedermawanan, dan anugerah — wahai Yang Maha Mulia, wahai Yang Maha Pemberi! Angkatlah kami ke kedudukan kedekatan tertinggi dengan-Mu, bersama hamba-hamba yang Engkau istimewakan sebagai ahli kasih-Mu, ahli cinta-Mu, dan ahli kedekatan pada hadirat-Mu — semata karena karunia, kedermawanan, dan kemurahan-Mu.
passages.en: Be with us in this moment as is befitting of You. Treat us in all circumstances and at all times as is befitting of You, and show us pure grace, generosity and favour, O Most Generous, O Giver of all gifts! Raise us to the highest stations of nearness to You, in the company of those of Your servants whom You have specially chosen as the people of Your affection, the people of Your love, and the people brought near to Your presence — purely by Your grace and generosity.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَاشْمَلْ (اللَّهُمَّ) بِرِعَايَتِكَ الكُبْرَى أَوْلَادَنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَذَوِينَا، وَأَحْبَابَنَا وَطُلَّابَنَا، وَالمُتَعَلِّقِينَ بِنَا خَاصَّةً وَالمُسْلِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Wasymalillâhumma biri`âyatikal-kubrâ aulâdanâ wa dzurriyyâtinâ wa dzawînâ, wa ahbâbanâ wa thullâbanâ, wal-muta`alliqîna binâ khâsshatan wal-muslimîn.
passages.id_: Liputilah, ya Allah, dengan pemeliharaan-Mu yang terbesar: anak-anak kami, keturunan kami, keluarga kami, orang-orang tercinta kami, murid-murid kami, mereka yang bertalian khusus dengan kami, dan segenap kaum muslimin.
passages.en: O Allah, envelop our children, our descendants, our family, our loved ones, our students, those especially connected to us, and all Muslims in Your greatest care.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا بِعَيْنِ العِنَايَةِ مَرْعِيِّينَ، فِي كُلِّ حَالٍ وَفِي كُلِّ حِينٍ، وَلَا تَصْرِفْنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ الحَضْرَةِ المُبَارَكَةِ إِلَّا بِنَظَرَاتٍ رَبَّانِيَّةٍ، وَفُيُوضَاتٍ إِحْسَانِيَّةٍ، وَامْتِنَانَاتٍ رَحْمَانِيَّةٍ، نُرْفَعُ بِهَا إِلَى أَعْلَى مَرَاتِبِ الصِّدِّيقِيَّةِ، وَتُصْلِحُ لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ شُؤُونِنَا وَأَحْوَالِنَا الدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ وَالبَرْزَخِيَّةِ وَالأُخْرَوِيَّةِ، وَنُعَافَى مِنْ جَمِيعِ الأَمْرَاضِ وَالآلَامِ وَالأَوْجَاعِ الحِسِّيَّةِ وَالمَعْنَوِيَّةِ، وَرَقِّنَا إِلَى أَعْلَى مَرَاتِبِ الصِّدْقِ مَعَكَ مَعَ أَهْلِ الصِّدِّيقِيَّةِ، وَأَثْبِتْنَا فِي أَهْلِ الخُصُوصِيَّةِ، وَهَبْ لَنَا المَزِيَّةَ، وَالمِنَنَ وَالمِنَحَ وَالمَوَاهِبَ الَّتِي جُدْتَ وَتَجُودُ بِهَا فِي زِيَارَةِ سَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ، اجْمَعْهَا لَنَا بِجَاهِهَا وَبِجَاهِ زَوْجِهَا سَيِّدِ الوُجُودِ، وَبِذُرِّيَّتِهَا أَجْمَعِينَ، فَضْلًا مِنْكَ وَمَنًّا وَجُودًا وَكَرَمًا.
passages.tr: Waj`alnâ bi`aynil-`inâyati mar`iyyîn, fî kulli hâlin wa fî kulli hîn, wa lâ tashrifnâ min hâdzihil-hadhratil-mubârakati illâ binazharâtin rabbâniyyah, wa fuyûdhâtin ihsâniyyah, wamtinânâtin rahmâniyyah, nurfa`u bihâ ilâ a`lâ marâtibish-shiddîqiyyah, wa tushlihu lanâ bihâ jamî`a syu'ûninâ wa ahwâlinad-dunyawiyyati wal-barzakhiyyati wal-ukhrawiyyah, wa nu`âfâ min jamî`il-amrâdhi wal-âlâmi wal-aujâ`il-hissiyyati wal-ma`nawiyyah, wa raqqinâ ilâ a`lâ marâtibish-shidqi ma`aka ma`a ahlish-shiddîqiyyah, wa atsbitnâ fî ahlil-khushûshiyyah, wa hab lanal-maziyyata, wal-minana wal-minaha wal-mawâhibal-latî judta wa tajûdu bihâ fî ziyârati sayyidatinâ Khadîjah, ijma`hâ lanâ bijâhihâ wa bijâhi zawjihâ sayyidil-wujûd, wa bidzurriyyatihâ ajma`în, fadhlan minka wa mannan wa jûdan wa karamâ.
passages.id_: Jadikanlah kami senantiasa terpelihara dalam pandangan inayah-Mu, dalam setiap keadaan dan setiap waktu. Janganlah Engkau memulangkan kami dari hadirat yang berkah ini kecuali dengan pandangan-pandangan rabbani, limpahan-limpahan ihsan, dan anugerah-anugerah rahmat, yang dengannya kami diangkat ke derajat shiddiqiyah tertinggi, Engkau perbaiki seluruh urusan dan keadaan kami di dunia, alam barzakh, dan akhirat, dan kami disembuhkan dari segala penyakit, derita, dan rasa sakit lahir maupun batin. Angkatlah kami ke derajat kejujuran tertinggi bersama-Mu, bersama ahli shiddiqiyah; teguhkanlah kami di antara orang-orang yang memiliki kedudukan khusus; dan anugerahilah kami keistimewaan, karunia, pemberian, dan anugerah yang telah dan senantiasa Engkau limpahkan dalam ziarah kepada junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah. Himpunkanlah semuanya bagi kami demi kedudukannya, kedudukan suaminya sang penghulu alam semesta, dan seluruh keturunannya — semata karena karunia, anugerah, kedermawanan, dan kemurahan-Mu.
passages.en: Keep us under the watchful eye of Your care in every situation and at every moment. Let us not depart from this blessed presence except with divine gazes, flows of beneficence, and merciful favors that raise us to the highest ranks of the utterly truthful. Set right every aspect of our lives in this world, in the life of the grave, and in the Hereafter. Heal us and grant us well-being from every illness, pain, and affliction, whether of body or of soul. Elevate us to the highest levels of truthfulness with You, alongside the people of truthfulness. Establish us among those of special standing before You. Grant us the distinction, blessings, and gifts that You have bestowed and continue to bestow on those who visit Sayyidatuna Khadijah. Gather all of it for us by her honor, the honor of her husband the Master of all existence, and by the honor of all her descendants, out of Your grace and generosity.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: يَا مَنْ عُهِدَ مِنْهُ الجُودُ، وَيَا مَوْلَى الفَضْلِ وَالمَنِّ وَالسُّعُودِ، وَيَا أَكْرَمَ الأَكْرَمِينَ، وَأَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَفَرِّجْ كُرُوبَنَا وَالمُسْلِمِينَ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Yâ man `uhida minhul-jûd, wa yâ maulal-fadhli wal-manni was-su`ûd, wa yâ akramal-akramîn, wa arhamar-râhimîn, wa farrij kurûbanâ wal-muslimîna ajma`în.
