passages.id_: Wahai Yang kedermawanan-Nya telah dikenal! Wahai Pemilik karunia, anugerah, dan keberuntungan! Wahai Yang paling mulia dari segala yang mulia, dan paling penyayang dari segala penyayang! Lapangkanlah kesulitan kami dan kesulitan segenap kaum muslimin.
passages.en: O the One whose generosity is ever known! O Master of favor, blessings and good fortune! O Most Generous, and Most Merciful! Relieve our distress and the distress of all Muslims.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَبَلِّغْ كُلًّا مِنَّا فَوْقَ مَا فِي نَفْسِهِ مِنَ الحَاجَاتِ، وَفَوْقَ المُرَادَاتِ وَالطَّلِبَاتِ، وَعَامِلْنَا بِالفَضْلِ، يَا عَظِيمَ الفَضْلِ، وَبِالإِحْسَانِ فِي كُلِّ شَانٍ، فِي السِّرِّ وَالإِعْلَانِ.
passages.tr: Wa balligh kullan minnâ fauqa mâ fî nafsihi minal-hâjât, wa fauqal-murâdâti wath-thalibât, wa `âmilnâ bil-fadhli, yâ `azhîmal-fadhli, wa bil-ihsâni fî kulli syân, fis-sirri wal-i`lân.
passages.id_: Sampaikanlah masing-masing kami melampaui hajat yang ada dalam dirinya, melampaui segala keinginan dan permohonan. Perlakukanlah kami dengan karunia, wahai Pemilik karunia yang agung, dan dengan kebaikan dalam setiap urusan, baik yang tersembunyi maupun yang tampak.
passages.en: Provide for each of us beyond our needs, desires and requests. Treat us with favor, O Great Bestower of Favor, and with goodness in every facet of our lives, both seen and unseen.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَعَلَى مَا نَوَتْهُ سَيِّدَتُنَا وَأُمُّنَا خَدِيجَةُ وَذُرِّيَّتُهَا الغَرَّاءُ، وَمَا نَوَاهُ الصَّالِحُونَ، وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُ اللَّهِ مِنْ صَالِحِ النِّيَّاتِ، فِي جَمِيعِ الحَالَاتِ، فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالبَرْزَخِ وَالآخِرَاتِ.
passages.tr: Wa `alâ mâ nawat-hu sayyidatunâ wa ummunâ Khadîjatu wa dzurriyyatuhal-gharrâ', wa mâ nawâhush-shâlihûn, wa mâ ahâtha bihi `ilmullâhi min shâlihin-niyyât, fî jamî`il-hâlât, fid-dunyâ wal-barzakhi wal-âkhirât.
passages.id_: Dan atas segala niat junjungan dan ibunda kami Sayyidah Khadijah beserta keturunannya yang cemerlang, niat orang-orang saleh, dan setiap niat baik yang diliputi ilmu Allah — dalam segala keadaan, di dunia, alam barzakh, dan akhirat.
passages.en: With the intentions of our Mother Sayyidatuna Khadijah and her illustrious descendants, and with the intentions of the righteous, and with every righteous intention that Allah's knowledge encompasses — in all circumstances, in this world, the intermediate realm, and the hereafter.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Khadijah and the People of Hajun
passages.ar: وَإِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ (الفَاتِحَةُ).
passages.tr: Wa ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi sayyidinâ Muhammadin shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam (al-Fâtihah).
passages.id_: Dan ke hadirat Nabi, junjungan kami Muhammad ﷺ (al-Fatihah).
passages.en: And unto the presence of the Prophet, our master Muhammad, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him (al-Fatihah).

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidatanâ Asmâ'a binta Abî Bakrinish-Shiddîq.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Sayyidah Asma binti Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our lady Asma bint Abi Bakr as-Siddiq.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا ذَاتَ النِّطَاقَيْنِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidatanâ dzâtan-nithâqayn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Dzatun Nithaqain — pemilik dua ikat pinggang.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our lady Dhat an-Nitaqayn — the one of the two waistbands.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى أَبِيكِ الصِّدِّيقِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ abîkish-Shiddîq.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas ayahandamu, ash-Shiddiq.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon your father, as-Siddiq.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى زَوْجِكِ الزُّبَيْرِ بنِ العَوَّامِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ zawjikiz-Zubayri bnil-`Awwâm.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas suamimu, az-Zubair bin al-Awwam.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon your husband, az-Zubayr bin al-Awwam.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى أُخْتِكِ أُمِّ المُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ ukhtiki Ummil-mu'minîna `Â'isyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas saudarimu, Ibunda kaum mukminin, Sayyidah Aisyah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon your sister, the Mother of the Believers, A'ishah.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَنَا عَبْدَ اللهِ بنَ الزُّبَيْرِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidanâ `Abdallâhi bnaz-Zubayr.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjungan kami Abdullah bin az-Zubair.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our master Abdullah bin az-Zubayr.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ ashhâbi rasûlillâhi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian dan atas segenap sahabat Rasulullah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon all the Companions of Allah's Messenger.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللهِ، وَبِرَسُولِ اللهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِ اللهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum fî rasûlillâhi, wa birasûlillâhi, `adada khalqillâhi, wa ridhâ nafsihi, wa zinata `arsyihi, wa midâda kalimâtih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian dalam Rasulullah dan dengan wasilah Rasulullah — sejumlah ciptaan Allah, seluas keridhaan-Nya, seberat Arasy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta firman-firman-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you in Allah's Messenger and through Allah's Messenger — by the number of Allah's creation, the extent of His good-pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: الفَاتِحَةُ، وَآيَةُ الكُرْسِيِّ، وَالإِخْلَاصِ (٣ مَرَّاتٍ)، وَالمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ (٣ مَرَّاتٍ).
passages.tr: Al-Fâtihah, wa âyatul-Kursî, wal-Ikhlâsh (3x), wal-Mu`awwidzatayn (3x).
passages.id_: Bacalah al-Fatihah, Ayat Kursi, Surah al-Ikhlas (3 kali), dan al-Mu'awwidzatain (3 kali).
passages.en: Recite al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, Surah al-Ikhlas (three times), and the two Surahs of refuge, al-Falaq and an-Nas (three times).

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) أَوْصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا قَرَأْنَا مِنَ القُرْآنِ العَظِيمِ مُضَاعَفًا بِمَا أَنْتَ لَهُ أَهْلٌ إِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا، وَحَبِيبِنَا، وَشَفِيعِنَا رَسُولِ اللهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ، وَمَنْ ذَكَرْنَاهُمْ فِي السَّلَامِ، وَأَرْوَاحِ جَمِيعِ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُسْلِمِينَ.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) aushil tsawâba mâ qara'nâ minal-Qur'ânil-`azhîmi mudhâ`afan bimâ anta lahu ahlun ilâ rûhi sayyidinâ, wa habîbinâ, wa syafî`inâ rasûlillâhi wa âlihi wa shahbihi, wa man dzakarnâhum fis-salâm, wa arwâhi jamî`il-mu'minîna wal-muslimîn.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) sampaikanlah pahala apa yang telah kami baca dari al-Qur'an yang agung — dilipatgandakan sebagaimana layak bagi kemurahan-Mu — kepada ruh junjungan kami, kekasih kami, dan pemberi syafaat kami, Rasulullah, beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau, dan mereka yang telah kami sebutkan dalam salam, serta kepada arwah segenap kaum mukminin dan muslimin.
passages.en: (O Allah,) convey the reward of what we have recited of the Mighty Qur'an, multiplied as befits You, to the soul of our master, our beloved and our intercessor, the Messenger of Allah, and his Family and Companions, and those we have mentioned in our salutations, and to the souls of all the believers and the Muslims.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: وَبِحَقِّهِمْ -يَا رَبِّ- اقْبَلْنَا، وَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَنَا، وَاحْفَظْنَا، وَاكْفِنَا مَا أَهَمَّنَا، وَتَوَلَّنَا، وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa bihaqqihim -yâ rabbi- iqbalnâ, wanzhur ilaynâ, wa ashlih ahwâlanâ, wahfazhnâ, wakfinâ mâ ahammanâ, wa tawallanâ, wa adkhilnâ fî `ibâdikash-shâlihîn.
passages.id_: Dan demi hak mereka — ya Rabb — terimalah kami, pandanglah kami, perbaikilah keadaan kami, jagalah kami, cukupilah segala yang menjadi kepentingan kami, uruslah kami, dan masukkanlah kami ke dalam golongan hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh.
passages.en: And by their right, O Lord, accept us, look upon us, set right our affairs, protect us, suffice us in all that concerns us, take charge of us, and admit us among Your righteous servants.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: وَاجْمَعْ لَنَا فِي هَذِهِ الزِّيَارَةِ خَيْرَاتِ الدَّارَيْنِ، وَاقْضِ حَوَائِجَنَا.
passages.tr: Wajma` lanâ fî hâdzihiz-ziyârati khayrâtid-dârayn, waqdhi hawâ'ijanâ.
passages.id_: Himpunkanlah bagi kami dalam ziarah ini kebaikan dunia dan akhirat, dan tunaikanlah hajat-hajat kami.
passages.en: Gather for us in this visit the good of both abodes, and fulfil our needs.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: وَارْحَمِ الأُمَّةَ، وَاكْشِفِ الغُمَّةَ، وَفَرِّجْ كُرُوبَ المُسْلِمِينَ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Warhamil-ummata, waksyifil-ghummata, wa farrij kurûbal-muslimîna ajma`în.
passages.id_: Kasihanilah umat ini, singkapkanlah kesusahannya, dan lapangkanlah kesulitan segenap kaum muslimin.
passages.en: Have mercy on the Ummah, lift away its distress, and relieve the sorrows of all the Muslims.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr and Abdullah bin az-Zubayr
passages.ar: بِسِرِّ الفَاتِحَةِ إِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
passages.tr: Bisirril-Fâtihah, ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi shallallâhu `alayhi wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa sallam.
passages.id_: Dengan rahasia al-Fatihah — ke hadirat Nabi, semoga Allah melimpahkan shalawat dan salam kepada beliau, keluarga, dan para sahabat beliau.
passages.en: By the secret of al-Fatihah — to the presence of the Prophet, may Allah bestow prayers and peace upon him, his Family and Companions.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا مَيْمُونَةُ بِنْتَ الحَارِثِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ sayyidatanâ Maymûnatu bintal-Hârits wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjungan kami Sayyidah Maimunah binti al-Harits, beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our lady Maymunah bint al-Harith, and Allah's mercy and His blessings.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ المُؤْمِنِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ Ummal-mu'minîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai Ibunda kaum mukminin.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O Mother of the Believers.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَوْجَةَ رَسُولِ اللهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ zawjata rasûlillâhi fid-dunyâ wal-âkhirah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai istri Rasulullah di dunia dan akhirat.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O wife of Allah's Messenger in this world and the Hereafter.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى سَيِّدِنَا رَسُولِ اللهِ، وَبِرَسُولِ اللهِ، وَفِي رَسُولِ اللهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ sayyidinâ rasûlillâhi, wa birasûlillâhi, wa fî rasûlillâh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas junjungan kami Rasulullah — dengan wasilah Rasulullah dan dalam Rasulullah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon our master, the Messenger of Allah — through the Messenger of Allah and in the Messenger of Allah.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى سَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ بِنْتِ خُوَيْلِدَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ sayyidatinâ Khadîjata binti Khuwaylid.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah binti Khuwailid.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon our lady Khadijah bint Khuwaylid.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى سَيِّدَتِنَا عَائِشَةَ الصِّدِّيقَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ sayyidatinâ `Â'isyatash-Shiddîqah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas junjungan kami Sayyidah Aisyah ash-Shiddiqah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon our lady A'ishah, the ever-truthful.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ سَوْدَةَ، وَحَفْصَةَ، وَزَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ خُزَيْمَةَ، وَزَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ، وَأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، وَجُوَيْرِيَةَ، وَصَفِيَّةَ، وَأُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ ummahâtil-mu'minîna Saudata, wa Hafshata, wa Zaynaba binti Khuzaymah, wa Zaynaba binti Jahsyin, wa Ummi Salamah, wa Juwayriyah, wa Shafiyyah, wa Ummi Habîbah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas para Ibunda kaum mukminin: Saudah, Hafshah, Zainab binti Khuzaimah, Zainab binti Jahsy, Ummu Salamah, Juwairiyah, Shafiyyah, dan Ummu Habibah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon the Mothers of the Believers: Sawdah, Hafsah, Zaynab bint Khuzaymah, Zaynab bint Jahsh, Umm Salamah, Juwayriyah, Safiyyah, and Umm Habibah.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ بِسِرِّ العِنَايَةِ فَانْتَهَيْتِ إِلَى حَبِيبِكِ فِي مَحَلِّ زَفَافِكِ بِهِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki bisirril-`inâyati fantahayti ilâ habîbiki fî mahalli zafâfiki bih.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu — berkat rahasia inayah Allah engkau berpulang menuju kekasihmu di tempat pernikahanmu dengannya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you — by the secret of divine care you were brought at the last to your beloved, at the very place of your wedding to him.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى سَيِّدَتِنَا فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ، وَزَيْنَبَ، وَرُقَيَّةَ، وَأُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ sayyidatinâ Fâthimataz-Zahrâ', wa Zaynaba, wa Ruqayyah, wa Ummi Kultsûm.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas junjungan kami Sayyidah Fathimah az-Zahra, Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon our lady Fatimah az-Zahra, and Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى آلِ رَسُولِ اللهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ âli rasûlillâhi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas segenap keluarga Rasulullah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon all the Family of Allah's Messenger.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَشَرَّفَ بِكِ الوَادِي.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki yâ man tasyarrafa bikil-wâdî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai engkau yang dengannya lembah ini menjadi mulia.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O you by whom this valley was ennobled.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى أَخَوَاتِكِ زَيْنَبَ، وَلُبَابَةَ، وَأَسْمَاءَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ akhawâtiki Zaynaba, wa Lubâbah, wa Asmâ'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas saudari-saudarimu: Zainab, Lubabah, dan Asma.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon your sisters Zaynab, Lubabah, and Asma.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ رِجَالًا وَنِسَاءً.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayki wa `alâ ashhâbi rasûlillâhi rijâlan wa nisâ'â.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu dan atas para sahabat Rasulullah, laki-laki maupun perempuan.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon the Companions of Allah's Messenger, men and women alike.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: الفَاتِحَة، وَيس.
passages.tr: Al-Fâtihah, wa Yâsîn.
passages.id_: Bacalah al-Fatihah dan Surah Yasin.
passages.en: Recite al-Fatihah and Surah Ya-Sin.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.id_: Kemudian membaca:
passages.en: Then one says:

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَمَنْ وَالَاهُ.
passages.tr: Al-hamdu lillâhi wash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alâ rasûlillâhi wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa man wâlâh.
passages.id_: Segala puji bagi Allah, dan shalawat serta salam atas Rasulullah, keluarga beliau, para sahabat beliau, dan siapa saja yang setia mengikuti beliau.
passages.en: Praise be to Allah, and prayers and peace be upon Allah's Messenger, his Family, his Companions, and those who follow him.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَوْصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا قَرَأْنَاهُ مِنَ القُرْآنِ العَظِيمِ مُضَاعَفًا بِمَا أَنْتَ لَهُ أَهْلٌ إِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا وَحَبِيبِنَا وَشَفِيعِنَا رَسُولِ اللهِ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ، ثُمَّ إِلَى رُوحِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ وَآلِهِمْ وَصَحْبِهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، ثُمَّ إِلَى رُوحِ صَاحِبَةِ المَقَامِ سَيِّدَتِنَا أُمِّ المُؤْمِنِينَ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الحَارِثِ، وَمَنْ ذُكِرُوا فِي السَّلَامِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma aushil tsawâba mâ qara'nâhu minal-Qur'ânil-`azhîmi mudhâ`afan bimâ anta lahu ahlun ilâ rûhi sayyidinâ wa habîbinâ wa syafî`inâ rasûlillâhi Muhammadi bni `Abdillâh, tsumma ilâ rûhi ikhwânihi minal-anbiyâ'i wal-mursalîna wa âlihim wa shahbihim ajma`în, tsumma ilâ rûhi shâhibatil-maqâmi sayyidatinâ Ummil-mu'minîna Maymûnata bintil-Hârits, wa man dzukirû fis-salâm.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, sampaikanlah pahala apa yang telah kami baca dari al-Qur'an yang agung — dilipatgandakan sebagaimana layak bagi kemurahan-Mu — kepada ruh junjungan kami, kekasih kami, dan pemberi syafaat kami, Rasulullah Muhammad bin Abdullah; kemudian kepada ruh saudara-saudara beliau dari kalangan para nabi dan rasul beserta segenap keluarga dan sahabat mereka; kemudian kepada ruh pemilik maqam ini, junjungan kami Ibunda kaum mukminin Maimunah binti al-Harits, serta mereka yang telah disebutkan dalam salam.
passages.en: O Allah, convey the reward of what we have recited of the Mighty Qur'an, multiplied as befits You, to the soul of our master, our beloved and our intercessor, the Messenger of Allah, Muhammad bin Abdullah; then to the souls of his brothers among the Prophets and Messengers, with all their Families and Companions; then to the soul of the lady of this resting place, our lady the Mother of the Believers, Maymunah bint al-Harith, and of those mentioned in our salutations.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: وَإِلَى أَرْوَاحِ مَشَايِخِنَا وَآبَائِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ arwâhi masyâyikhinâ wa âbâ'inâ wa ummahâtinâ wal-muslimîna wal-muslimât.
passages.id_: Dan kepada arwah guru-guru kami, ayah-ayah dan ibu-ibu kami, serta kaum muslimin dan muslimat.
passages.en: And to the souls of our teachers, our fathers and our mothers, and of the Muslim men and women.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: وَبِجَاهِهِمْ عَلَيْكَ اقْبَلِ الزِّيَارَةَ، وَعَجِّلْ بِالبِشَارَةِ، وَافْتَحْ لَنَا أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَكْرِمْنَا بِقَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِنَا كُلِّهَا مَا عَلِمْنَا مِنْهَا، وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ.
passages.tr: Wa bijâhihim `alayka iqbaliz-ziyârata, wa `ajjil bil-bisyârati, waftah lanâ abwâba fadhlika wa rahmatika, wa akrimnâ biqadhâ'i hawâ'ijinâ kullihâ mâ `alimnâ minhâ, wa mâ lam na`lam.
passages.id_: Demi kedudukan mereka di sisi-Mu, terimalah ziarah ini, segerakanlah kabar gembira, bukakanlah bagi kami pintu-pintu karunia dan rahmat-Mu, dan muliakanlah kami dengan terkabulnya seluruh hajat kami — yang kami ketahui maupun yang tidak kami ketahui.
passages.en: By their standing with You, accept this visit, hasten the glad tidings, open for us the gates of Your bounty and Your mercy, and honour us by fulfilling all our needs — those of them we know and those we do not.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا كُلَّهَا أَوَّلَهَا وَآخِرَهَا، ظَاهِرَهَا وَبَاطِنَهَا، مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ، وَمَا عَلِمْنَا مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ.
passages.tr: Waghfir lanâ dzunûbanâ kullahâ awwalahâ wa âkhirahâ, zhâhirahâ wa bâthinahâ, mâ taqaddama minhâ wa mâ ta'akhkhara, wa mâ `alimnâ minhâ wa mâ lam na`lam.
passages.id_: Dan ampunilah seluruh dosa kami — yang awal dan yang akhir, yang lahir dan yang batin, yang telah lalu dan yang kemudian, yang kami ketahui maupun yang tidak kami ketahui.
passages.en: And forgive us all our sins — the first of them and the last, the outward and the inward, those that have gone before and those that come after, those we know and those we do not.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِوَالِدِينَا وَأَمْوَاتِنَا وَأَمْوَاتِ المُسْلِمِينَ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَأَعْطِنَا فِي زِيَارَتِنَا أَفْضَلَ مَا تُعْطِي الزَّائِرِينَ لِعِبَادِكَ المَحْبُوبِينَ، وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ الَّذِينَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ.
passages.tr: Waghfir liwâlidînâ wa amwâtinâ wa amwâtil-muslimîna ajma`în, wa a`thinâ fî ziyâratinâ afdhala mâ tu`thiz-zâ'irîna li`ibâdikal-mahbûbîn, wa adkhilnâ fî `ibâdikash-shâlihîn, waj`alnâ min auliyâ'ikal-ladzîna lâ khaufun `alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn.
passages.id_: Ampunilah kedua orang tua kami, orang-orang kami yang telah wafat, dan segenap kaum muslimin yang telah wafat; berikanlah kepada kami dalam ziarah ini sebaik-baik apa yang Engkau berikan kepada para peziarah hamba-hamba-Mu yang tercinta; masukkanlah kami ke dalam golongan hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh; dan jadikanlah kami termasuk para wali-Mu yang tiada rasa takut atas mereka dan tiada pula mereka bersedih hati.
passages.en: Forgive our parents, our departed ones, and all the departed Muslims; grant us in our visit the best of what You grant those who visit Your beloved servants; admit us among Your righteous servants; and make us of Your friends — upon whom there is no fear, nor shall they grieve.

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أُمَّةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّجْ كُرُوبَهُمْ، وَأَصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَهُمْ، وَارْحَمْ أَمْوَاتَهُمْ، وَاجْمَعْ شَمْلَهُمْ، وَاهْدِ ضَالَّهُمْ، وَقَوِّمْ مُعْوَجَّهُمْ، وَرُدَّ غَائِبَهُمْ، بِسِرِّ الفَاتِحَةِ...
passages.tr: Allâhummarham ummata sayyidinâ Muhammadin shallallâhu `alayhi wa sallam. Allâhumma farrij kurûbahum, wa ashlih ahwâlahum, warham amwâtahum, wajma` syamlahum, wahdi dhâllahum, wa qawwim mu`wajjahum, wa rudda ghâ'ibahum, bisirril-Fâtihah...
passages.id_: Ya Allah, kasihanilah umat junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Ya Allah, lapangkanlah kesulitan mereka, perbaikilah keadaan mereka, kasihanilah orang-orang mereka yang telah wafat, himpunkanlah yang tercerai-berai di antara mereka, tunjukilah yang tersesat, luruskanlah yang menyimpang, dan kembalikanlah yang jauh dari mereka — dengan rahasia al-Fatihah…
passages.en: O Allah, have mercy on the Ummah of our master Muhammad ﷺ. O Allah, relieve their sorrows, set right their affairs, have mercy on their departed, unite their scattered, guide their astray, straighten their crooked, and return their absent — by the secret of al-Fatihah…

passages.sub: Visiting Sayyidah Maymunah
passages.id_: Kemudian berdoa sesuai hajatnya.
passages.en: Then one supplicates as one wishes.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا عَتَّابَ بِنْ أُسَيْدٍ يَا صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللهِ وَأَمِيرَ مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanâ `Attâba bin Usayd, yâ shâhiba rasûlillâhi wa amîra Makkatal-mukarramah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Attab bin Usaid — sahabat Rasulullah dan amir kota Makkah al-Mukarramah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our master Attab bin Usayd — O Companion of Allah's Messenger and governor of Makkah the Ennobled.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا الفُضَيْلَ بِنْ عِيَاضٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ بِنْ أَدْهَمَ وَابْنَ حَجَرٍ الهَيْتَمِيِّ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanal-Fudhayla bin `Iyâdhin wa Ibrâhîma bin Adhama wabna Hajarinil-Haytamî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami al-Fudhail bin Iyadh, Ibrahim bin Adham, dan Ibnu Hajar al-Haitami.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our masters al-Fudayl bin Iyad, Ibrahim bin Adham, and Ibn Hajar al-Haytami.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ أَجْمَعِين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ashhâbi rasûlillâhi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas segenap sahabat Rasulullah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon all the Companions of Allah's Messenger.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدَ بِنْ عَلَوِيِّ السَّقَافِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanâ Muhammada bin `Alawiyyis-Saqqâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Muhammad bin Alwi as-Saqqaf.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our master Muhammad bin Alawi as-Saqqaf.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا عَلَوِي بِنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ الحَدَّادِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanâ `Alawî bin `Abdillâhil-Haddâd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Alwi bin Abdullah al-Haddad.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our master Alawi bin Abdullah al-Haddad.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَعَلَى أُصُولِكُمْ وَعَلَى فُرُوعِكُمْ أَجْمَعِين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu wa `alâ ushûlikum wa `alâ furû`ikum ajma`în.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, dan atas seluruh leluhur serta segenap keturunan kalian.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, and upon your forebears and your descendants, one and all.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنَا بِهِمْ وَأَعِدْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ أَسْرَارِهِمْ وَأَنْوَارِهِمْ وَعُلُومِهِمْ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِهِمْ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَفِيهِمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhumman-fa`nâ bihim wa a`id `alaynâ min asrârihim wa anwârihim wa `ulûmihim, warfa` darajâtihim ma`an-nabiyyîna wash-shiddîqîna wasy-syuhadâ'i wash-shâlihîn, waj`alnâ minhum wa fîhim.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, berilah kami manfaat melalui mereka, limpahkanlah kembali kepada kami dari rahasia-rahasia, cahaya-cahaya, dan ilmu-ilmu mereka; angkatlah derajat mereka bersama para nabi, para shiddiqin, para syuhada, dan orang-orang saleh; dan jadikanlah kami bagian dari mereka dan berada di tengah-tengah mereka.
passages.en: O Allah, grant us benefit through them, and pour back upon us something of their secrets, their lights, and their knowledge; raise their degrees together with the Prophets, the most truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous; and make us of them and among them.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: وَنَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِجَاهِهِمْ أَنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنْ أُمَّةِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَرْحَمَهُمْ وَتُصْلِحَ شَأْنَهُمْ وَتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ، وَتُكْرِمَنَا فِي وُقُوفِنَا بِبَابِهِمْ بِكَرَامَةٍ تَلِيقُ بِجُودِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ.
passages.tr: Wa nas'alukallâhumma bijâhihim an tufarrija `an ummati sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa tarhamahum wa tushliha sya'nahum wa taghfira lahum, wa tukrimanâ fî wuqûfinâ bibâbihim bikarâmatin talîqu bijûdika wa ihsânik.
passages.id_: Dan kami memohon kepada-Mu, ya Allah, demi kedudukan mereka, agar Engkau melapangkan kesulitan umat junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, mengasihi mereka, memperbaiki urusan mereka, dan mengampuni mereka; serta memuliakan kami dalam berdirinya kami di pintu mereka dengan kemuliaan yang layak bagi kedermawanan dan kebaikan-Mu.
passages.en: And we ask You, O Allah, by their standing, to bring relief to the Ummah of our master Muhammad, to have mercy on them, to set right their affairs, and to forgive them; and to honour us, as we stand at their door, with an honouring that befits Your generosity and Your beneficence.

passages.sub: Visiting Attab bin Usayd
passages.ar: وَإِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ الفَاتِحَةِ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi, al-Fâtihah.
passages.id_: Dan ke hadirat Nabi — al-Fatihah.
passages.en: And to the presence of the Prophet — al-Fatihah.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ أَهْلَ البَيْتِ ﴿إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا﴾.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu ahlal-bayt. Innamâ yurîdullâhu liyudzhiba `ankumur-rijsa ahlal-bayti wa yuthahhirakum tathhîrâ.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai Ahlul Bait. "Sesungguhnya Allah hanya bermaksud menghilangkan noda dari kalian, wahai Ahlul Bait, dan menyucikan kalian sesuci-sucinya." [Surah al-Ahzab 33:33]
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O People of the House. "Allah only wishes to remove all impurity from you, O People of the House, and to purify you completely" [Surah al-Ahzab 33:33].

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا سَيِّدَنَا الحَبِيبَ عَبْدَ القَادِرِ بنَ أَحْمَدَ السَّقَافَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ sayyidanal-Habîba `Abdal-Qâdiri bna Ahmadas-Saqqâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjungan kami Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our master, Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا حَسَنَ الأَوْصَافِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ hasanal-aushâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai pemilik sifat-sifat yang indah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O you of beautiful qualities.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا وَارِثَ الأَسْلَافِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ wâritsal-aslâf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai pewaris para leluhur yang saleh.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the pious forebears.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا سَيِّدَنَا الحَبِيبَ عَيْدَرُوسَ بِنْ سَالِمٍ البَارَ. وَسَيِّدَنَا الحَبِيبَ مُحَمَّدَ بِنْ حُسَيْنَ الحَبَشِيَّ وَأَوْلَادَهُ. وَسَيِّدَنَا الشَّيْخَ حَسَنَ المَشَّاطَ. وَسَيِّدَنَا الحَبِيبَ حَسَنَ فَدْعَق.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ sayyidanal-Habîba `Aydarûsa bin Sâlimil-Bâr, wa sayyidanal-Habîba Muhammada bin Husaynil-Habasyiyya wa aulâdah, wa sayyidanasy-Syaykha Hasanal-Masysyâth, wa sayyidanal-Habîba Hasan Fad`aq.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai junjungan kami Habib Aidarus bin Salim al-Bar; junjungan kami Habib Muhammad bin Husain al-Habsyi beserta putra-putranya; junjungan kami Syekh Hasan al-Masysyath; dan junjungan kami Habib Hasan Fad'aq.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our master Habib Aydarus bin Salim al-Bar; and our master Habib Muhammad bin Husayn al-Habashi and his children; and our master Shaykh Hasan al-Mashshat; and our master Habib Hasan Fad'aq.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا حَبِيبَنَا أَحْمَدَ مَشْهُورِ الحَدَّادِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ habîbanâ Ahmada Masyhûril-Haddâd.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai kekasih kami Ahmad Masyhur al-Haddad.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our beloved Ahmad Mashhur al-Haddad.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا حَبِيبَنَا عَطَّاسِ الحَبَشِيِّ. وَحَبِيبَنَا عَلِيِّ المَشْهُورِ. وَحَبِيبَنَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الكَافِ. وَحَبِيبَنَا مُحَمَّدِ الهَدَّارِ. وَحَبِيبَنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الشَّاطِرِيِّ. وَحَبِيبَنَا حَامِدِ بنِ عَلَوِيِّ الحَدَّادِ. وَحَبِيبَنَا مُحَمَّدٍ رَشَادِ البَيْتِيِّ. وَحَبِيبَنَا سَالِمِ الشَّاطِرِيِّ. وَحَبِيبَنَا عَلِيِّ عَبْدِ اللهِ السَّقَافِ. وَحَبِيبَنَا شِهَابِ الدِّينِ المَشْهُورِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ habîbanâ `Aththâsil-Habasyî, wa habîbanâ `Aliyyil-Masyhûr, wa habîbanâ `Abdir-Rahmânil-Kâf, wa habîbanâ Muhammadil-Haddâr, wa habîbanâ Muhammadinisy-Syâthirî, wa habîbanâ Hâmidi bni `Alawiyyil-Haddâd, wa habîbanâ Muhammadin Rasyâdil-Baytî, wa habîbanâ Sâlimisy-Syâthirî, wa habîbanâ `Aliyyi `Abdillâhis-Saqqâf, wa habîbanâ Syihâbid-dînil-Masyhûr.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai kekasih kami Atthas al-Habsyi; kekasih kami Ali al-Masyhur; kekasih kami Abdurrahman al-Kaf; kekasih kami Muhammad al-Haddar; kekasih kami Muhammad asy-Syathiri; kekasih kami Hamid bin Alwi al-Haddad; kekasih kami Muhammad Rasyad al-Baiti; kekasih kami Salim asy-Syathiri; kekasih kami Ali Abdullah as-Saqqaf; dan kekasih kami Syihabuddin al-Masyhur.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O our beloved Attas al-Habashi; and our beloved Ali al-Mashhur; and our beloved Abdurrahman al-Kaf; and our beloved Muhammad al-Haddar; and our beloved Muhammad ash-Shatiri; and our beloved Hamid bin Alawi al-Haddad; and our beloved Muhammad Rashad al-Bayti; and our beloved Salim ash-Shatiri; and our beloved Ali Abdullah as-Saqqaf; and our beloved Shihabuddin al-Mashhur.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَلَى الحَبِيبِ طَهَ بِنِ عُمَرَ الصَّافِيِّ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alal-Habîbi Thâhâ bini `Umarash-Shâfî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian dan atas Habib Thaha bin Umar ash-Shafi.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon Habib Taha bin Umar as-Safi.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَلَى مَوْلَى الشَّبِيكَةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa `alâ maulasy-Syabîkah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian dan atas tuan pemilik kawasan asy-Syabikah.
passages.en: Peace be upon you and upon the master of ash-Shabikah.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، أَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ، غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ، وَإِنَّا -إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ- بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، يَرْحَمُ اللهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ. نَسْأَلُ اللهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ العَافِيَةَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum dâra qaumin mu'minîn, atâkum mâ tû`adûn, ghadan mu'ajjalûn, wa innâ -insyâ Allâhu- bikum lâhiqûn, yarhamullâhul-mustaqdimîna minkum wal-musta'khirîn. Nas'alullâha lanâ wa lakumul-`âfiyah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai penghuni negeri kaum beriman. Telah datang kepada kalian apa yang dijanjikan; esok hanyalah waktu yang ditangguhkan, dan kami — insya Allah — akan menyusul kalian. Semoga Allah merahmati mereka yang mendahului di antara kalian dan yang datang kemudian. Kami memohon kepada Allah keselamatan bagi kami dan bagi kalian.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O abode of believing people. What you were promised has come to you; tomorrow is but deferred, and we — if Allah wills — shall join you. May Allah have mercy on those of you who went ahead and those who follow after. We ask Allah for wellbeing, for us and for you.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، مِنْ أَهْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، كَيْفَ وَجَدْتُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ؟
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum yâ ahla lâ ilâha illallâh, min ahli lâ ilâha illallâh, kayfa wajadtum lâ ilâha illallâh?
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian, wahai ahli la ilaha illallah, dari ahli la ilaha illallah: bagaimana kalian mendapati la ilaha illallah?
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O people of la ilaha illallah, from people of la ilaha illallah: how have you found la ilaha illallah?

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، كُنْ لَنَا وَلِمَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) bihaqqi lâ ilâha illallâh, kun lanâ wa liman qâla: lâ ilâha illallâh.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) demi kebenaran la ilaha illallah, jadilah Penolong bagi kami dan bagi siapa saja yang mengucapkan: la ilaha illallah.
passages.en: (O Allah,) by the right of la ilaha illallah, be there for us and for everyone who has said: la ilaha illallah.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) رَبَّ الأَرْوَاحِ البَاقِيَةِ، وَالأَجْسَامِ البَالِيَةِ الَّتِي خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا، وَهِيَ بِكَ مُؤْمِنَةٌ، أَدْخِلْ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ رُوحًا مِنْكَ، وَسَلَامًا مِنَّا.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) rabbal-arwâhil-bâqiyati, wal-ajsâmil-bâliyatil-latî kharajat minad-dunyâ, wa hiya bika mu'minah, adkhil `alayhim fî qubûrihim rauhan minka, wa salâman minnâ.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) Tuhan segala ruh yang kekal dan jasad-jasad yang telah hancur, yang meninggalkan dunia dalam keadaan beriman kepada-Mu — masukkanlah kepada mereka di dalam kubur mereka ketenteraman dari-Mu dan salam dari kami.
passages.en: (O Allah,) Lord of the enduring souls and of the worn-away bodies that left this world believing in You — let enter upon them in their graves solace from You, and greetings of peace from us.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: سَلَامُ اللهِ -يَا سَادَه- * مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ يَغْشَاكُم. عِبَادَ اللهِ جِئْنَاكُم * قَصَدْنَاكُمْ، طَلَبْنَاكُم. تُعِينُونَا، تُغِيثُونَا * بِهِمَّتِكُمْ، وَجَدْوَاكُم. فَأَحْبُونَا، وَأَعْطُونَا * عَطَايَاكُمْ، هَدَايَاكُم.
passages.tr: Salâmullâhi -yâ sâdah- * minar-Rahmâni yaghsyâkum. `Ibâdallâhi ji'nâkum * qashadnâkum, thalabnâkum. Tu`înûnâ, tughîtsûnâ * bihimmatikum, wa jadwâkum. Fa ahbûnâ, wa a`thûnâ * `athâyâkum, hadâyâkum.
passages.id_: Salam Allah — wahai para sayyid — dari Yang Maha Pengasih meliputi kalian. Wahai hamba-hamba Allah, kami datang kepada kalian; kami menuju dan mengharapkan kalian. Tolonglah kami, bantulah kami, dengan himmah dan kemurahan kalian. Maka sambutlah kami dan berilah kami pemberian dan hadiah kalian.
passages.en: The peace of Allah, O masters, from the All-Merciful envelop you. O servants of Allah, we have come to you; we have sought you out and called upon you. Aid us and come to our rescue, by your lofty resolve and your bounty. So receive us kindly, and grant us your gifts and your presents.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: فَلَا خَيَّبْتُمُ ظَنِّي * فَحَاشَاكُمْ، وَحَاشَاكُم. سَعِدْنَا، إِذْ أَتَيْنَاكُم * وَفُزْنَا حِينَ زُرْنَاكُم. فَقُومُوا، وَاشْفَعُوا فِينَا * إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ مَوْلَاكُم. عَسَى نُحْظَى، عَسَى نُعْطَى * مَزَايَا مِنْ مَزَايَاكُم.
passages.tr: Falâ khayyabtumu zhannî * fahâsyâkum, wa hâsyâkum. Sa`idnâ, idz ataynâkum * wa fuznâ hîna zurnâkum. Faqûmû, wasyfa`û fînâ * ilar-Rahmâni maulâkum. `Asâ nuhzhâ, `asâ nu`thâ * mazâyâ min mazâyâkum.
passages.id_: Kalian tak akan mengecewakan harapanku — mustahil itu bagi kalian, sungguh mustahil! Kami berbahagia saat mendatangi kalian, dan beruntung saat menziarahi kalian. Maka bangkitlah dan berilah kami syafaat di hadapan Yang Maha Pengasih, Pelindung kalian. Semoga kami beroleh anugerah, semoga kami diberi keistimewaan dari keistimewaan kalian.
passages.en: Never would you disappoint my hope — far be it from you, far be it from you! We were gladdened when we came to you, and we prospered when we visited you. So rise and intercede for us with the All-Merciful, your Protector. That we may be favoured, that we may be granted merits from among your merits.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: عَسَى نَظْرَهْ، عَسَى رَحْمَهْ * تَغْشَانَا، وَتَغْشَاكُم. سَلَامُ اللهِ حَيَّاكُم * وَعَيْنُ اللهِ تَرْعَاكُم. وَصَلَّى اللهُ مَوْلَانَا * وَسَلَّمَ مَا أَتَيْنَاكُم. عَلَى المُخْتَارِ شَافِعِنَا * وَمُنْقِذِنَا، وَإِيَّاكُم. (آمِينَ)
passages.tr: `Asâ nazhrah, `asâ rahmah * taghsyânâ, wa taghsyâkum. Salâmullâhi hayyâkum * wa `aynullâhi tar`âkum. Wa shallallâhu maulânâ * wa sallama mâ ataynâkum. `Alal-Mukhtâri syâfi`inâ * wa munqidzinâ, wa iyyâkum. (Âmîn)
passages.id_: Semoga pandangan kasih, semoga rahmat, meliputi kami dan meliputi kalian. Salam Allah menyambut kalian, dan penjagaan Allah memelihara kalian. Dan semoga Allah, Pelindung kami, melimpahkan shalawat dan salam — selama kami terus mendatangi kalian — atas Nabi pilihan, pemberi syafaat dan penyelamat kami, dan juga atas kalian. (Amin)
passages.en: Perhaps a glance of grace, perhaps a mercy, will envelop us and envelop you. May Allah's peace greet you, and Allah's watchful eye guard you. And may Allah, our Protector, bestow prayers and peace — for as long as we keep coming to you — upon the Chosen One, our intercessor and our deliverer, and upon you. (Amin)

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: الفَاتِحَةُ، وَيس -أَثَابَكُمُ اللهُ-
passages.tr: Al-Fâtihah, wa Yâsîn -atsâbakumullâh-.
passages.id_: Bacalah al-Fatihah dan Surah Yasin — semoga Allah membalas kalian dengan pahala.
passages.en: Recite al-Fatihah and Surah Ya-Sin — may Allah reward you.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ مِنَّا ذَلِكَ، وَأَوْصَلَ ثَوَابَهُ مُضَاعَفًا إِلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا وَحَبِيبِنَا وَشَفِيعِنَا رَسُولِ اللهِ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ، وَسَيِّدَتِنَا فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ، وَسَيِّدِنَا عَلِيٍّ، وَالحَسَنِ، وَالحُسَيْنِ.
passages.tr: Taqabbalallâhu minnâ dzâlika, wa aushala tsawâbahu mudhâ`afan ilâ rûhi sayyidinâ wa habîbinâ wa syafî`inâ rasûlillâhi Muhammadi bni `Abdillâh, wa sayyidatinâ Fâthimataz-Zahrâ', wa sayyidinâ `Aliyyin, wal-Hasani, wal-Husayn.
passages.id_: Semoga Allah menerima bacaan itu dari kami dan menyampaikan pahalanya secara berlipat kepada ruh junjungan kami, kekasih kami, dan pemberi syafaat kami, Rasulullah Muhammad bin Abdullah; junjungan kami Sayyidah Fathimah az-Zahra, Sayyidina Ali, al-Hasan, dan al-Husain.
passages.en: May Allah accept this from us, and convey its reward, multiplied, to the soul of our master, our beloved and our intercessor, the Messenger of Allah, Muhammad bin Abdullah; and of our lady Fatimah az-Zahra, our master Ali, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَسَادَتِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ، وَعُثْمَانَ، وَالحَمْزَةَ، وَالعَبَّاسِ، وَآلِ بَيْتِ رَسُولِ اللهِ، وَأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa sâdatinâ Abî Bakrin, wa `Umara, wa `Utsmâna, wal-Hamzata, wal-`Abbâsi, wa âli bayti rasûlillâhi, wa ashhâbihi ajma`în.
passages.id_: Dan kepada junjungan kami Abu Bakar, Umar, Utsman, Hamzah, dan al-Abbas, serta Ahlul Bait Rasulullah dan segenap sahabat beliau.
passages.en: And of our masters Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Hamzah, and al-Abbas, and the Family of the House of Allah's Messenger, and all his Companions.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَإِلَى رُوحِ الإِمَامِ عَلِيٍّ زَيْنِ العَابِدِينَ، وَالبَاقِرِ، وَالصَّادِقِ، وَالعُرَيْضِيِّ، وَابْنِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَيْنِ النَّقِيبِ، وَالمُهَاجِرِ أَحْمَدَ بنِ عِيسَى، وَبَنِيهِ، وَصَاحِبِ مِرْبَاطٍ، وَخَالِعِ قَسَمٍ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ rûhil-Imâmi `Aliyyin Zaynil-`âbidîn, wal-Bâqiri, wash-Shâdiqi, wal-`Uraydhiyyi, wabnihi Muhammadin, wa `Aynin-Naqîb, wal-Muhâjiri Ahmada bni `Îsâ, wa banîhi, wa Shâhibi Mirbâth, wa Khâli`i Qasam.
passages.id_: Dan kepada ruh Imam Ali Zainal Abidin; al-Baqir, ash-Shadiq, dan al-Uraidhi beserta putranya Muhammad; an-Naqib yang mulia; al-Muhajir Ahmad bin Isa beserta putra-putranya; Shahib Mirbath; dan Khali' Qasam.
passages.en: And to the soul of Imam Ali Zayn al-Abidin; and of al-Baqir, as-Sadiq, and al-Uraydi and his son Muhammad; of the eminent an-Naqib; of al-Muhajir Ahmad bin Isa and his sons; of Sahib Mirbat; and of Khali' Qasam.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَالفَقِيهِ المُقَدَّمِ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ عَلِيٍّ، وَأَوْلَادِهِ، وَالسَّقَّافِ، وَالسَّكْرَانِ، وَالمِحْضَارِ، وَالعَيْدَرُوسِ، وَالشَّيْخِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بنِ سَالِمٍ، وَالشَّيْخِ عُمَرَ بنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ العَطَّاسِ، وَالحَبِيبِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بنِ عَلَوِيِّ الحَدَّادِ، وَالحَبِيبِ سَقَّافِ بنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَوْلَادِهِ، وَالحَبِيبِ عَلِيِّ الحَبَشِيِّ.
passages.tr: Wal-Faqîhil-Muqaddami Muhammadi bni `Aliyyin, wa aulâdihi, was-Saqqâfi, was-Sakrâni, wal-Mihdhâri, wal-`Aydarûsi, wasy-Syaykhi Abî Bakrin bni Sâlimin, wasy-Syaykhi `Umara bni `Abdir-Rahmânil-`Aththâsi, wal-Habîbi `Abdillâhi bni `Alawiyyil-Haddâdi, wal-Habîbi Saqqâfi bni Muhammadin, wa aulâdihi, wal-Habîbi `Aliyyil-Habasyî.
passages.id_: Dan kepada al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin Ali beserta putra-putranya; as-Saqqaf, as-Sakran, al-Mihdhar, dan al-Aidarus; Syekh Abu Bakar bin Salim; Syekh Umar bin Abdurrahman al-Atthas; Habib Abdullah bin Alwi al-Haddad; Habib Saqqaf bin Muhammad beserta putra-putranya; dan Habib Ali al-Habsyi.
passages.en: And of al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin Ali and his children; of as-Saqqaf, as-Sakran, al-Mihdar, and al-Aydarus; of Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim; of Shaykh Umar bin Abdurrahman al-Attas; of Habib Abdullah bin Alawi al-Haddad; of Habib Saqqaf bin Muhammad and his children; and of Habib Ali al-Habashi.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَجَمِيعِ سَادَاتِنَا آلِ بَاعَلَوِيٍّ، وَأَهْلِ البَقِيعِ، وَالحُجُونِ، وَمَا حَوَاهُ قَاعُ بَشَّارَ، وَأَهْلِ هَذِهِ الحَوْطَةِ مِنْ آلِ بَاعَلَوِيِّ الأَشْرَافِ، وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُمْ.
passages.tr: Wa jamî`i sâdâtinâ Âli Bâ`alawiyyin, wa ahlil-Baqî`i, wal-Hujûni, wa mâ hawâhu Qâ`u Basysyâra, wa ahli hâdzihil-hauthati min Âli Bâ`alawiyyil-asyrâfi, wa man haulahum.
passages.id_: Dan kepada seluruh junjungan kami keluarga Ba Alawi; ahli kubur Baqi dan al-Hajun; semua yang berada di lembah Basysyar; para penghuni hauthah ini dari keluarga Ba Alawi yang mulia; serta mereka yang di sekitar mereka.
passages.en: And of all our masters of the Al Ba Alawi; the people of al-Baqi and of al-Hajun; all whom the plain of Bashshar holds; the people of this hawtah from the noble Al Ba Alawi; and those around them.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَإِلَى أَرْوَاحِ جَمِيعِ الأَوْلِيَاءِ، وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَالمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ arwâhi jamî`il-auliyâ'i, wash-shâlihîna, wal-mu'minîna, wal-muslimîn.
passages.id_: Dan kepada arwah seluruh para wali, orang-orang saleh, kaum mukminin, dan muslimin.
passages.en: And to the souls of all the friends of Allah, the righteous, the believers, and the Muslims.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَبِحَقِّهِمْ عَلَيْكَ، وَبِمَا تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ. نَسْأَلُكَ (اللَّهُمَّ) أَنْ تَقْبَلَنَا، وَتُقْبِلَ بِوَجْهِكَ الكَرِيمِ عَلَيْنَا، وَتُدْخِلَنَا دَائِرَةَ أَوْلِيَائِكَ الَّذِينَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ.
passages.tr: Wa bihaqqihim `alayka, wa bimâ tafadhdhalta bihi `alayhim, nas'aluka (Allâhumma) an taqbalanâ, wa tuqbila biwajhikal-karîmi `alaynâ, wa tudkhilanâ dâ'irata auliyâ'ikal-ladzîna lâ khaufun `alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn.
passages.id_: Demi hak mereka di sisi-Mu dan demi karunia yang telah Engkau limpahkan kepada mereka, kami memohon kepada-Mu (ya Allah) agar Engkau menerima kami, menghadapkan wajah-Mu Yang Mulia kepada kami, dan memasukkan kami ke dalam lingkaran para wali-Mu yang tiada rasa takut atas mereka dan tiada pula mereka bersedih hati.
passages.en: By their right with You, and by the favours You have graced them with, we ask You (O Allah) to accept us, to turn Your Noble Countenance towards us, and to bring us into the circle of Your friends — upon whom there is no fear, nor shall they grieve.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَتَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ عِبَادِ الرَّحْمَنِ، الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ، وَتُكْرِمَنَا بِالعُبُودِيَّةِ المَحْضَةِ، وَالاسْتِغْنَاءِ عَنِ النَّاسِ.
passages.tr: Wa taj`alanâ min `ibâdir-Rahmânil-ladzîna laysa lisy-syaythâni `alayhim sulthân, wa tukrimanâ bil-`ubûdiyyatil-mahdhah, wal-istighnâ'i `anin-nâs.
passages.id_: Dan agar Engkau menjadikan kami hamba-hamba Yang Maha Pengasih yang setan tidak berkuasa atas mereka, serta memuliakan kami dengan penghambaan yang murni dan ketidakbergantungan kepada manusia.
passages.en: And to make us among the servants of the All-Merciful over whom Satan has no authority, and to honour us with pure servanthood and independence from people.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ) أَغْنِنَا بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَبِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ، وَاكْشِفْ كُرُوبَنَا، وَاغْفِرْ ذُنُوبَنَا، وَاسْتُرْ عُيُوبَنَا، وَارْزُقْنَا الصِّدْقَ، وَالإِخْلَاصَ، وَالمَعْرِفَةَ، وَالمَحَبَّةَ، وَاشْرَحْ صُدُورَنَا، وَيَسِّرْ أُمُورَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ أَزْوَاجَنَا، وَأَوْلَادَنَا.
passages.tr: (Allâhumma) aghninâ bihalâlika `an harâmika, wa bithâ`atika `an ma`shiyatika, wa bifadhlika `amman siwâka, waksyif kurûbanâ, waghfir dzunûbanâ, wastur `uyûbanâ, warzuqnash-shidqa, wal-ikhlâsha, wal-ma`rifata, wal-mahabbata, wasyrah shudûranâ, wa yassir umûranâ, wa ashlih azwâjanâ, wa aulâdanâ.
passages.id_: (Ya Allah,) cukupkanlah kami dengan yang halal dari-Mu sehingga terjauh dari yang haram; dengan ketaatan kepada-Mu sehingga terjauh dari maksiat; dan dengan karunia-Mu sehingga tidak bergantung kepada selain-Mu. Singkapkanlah kesusahan kami, ampunilah dosa-dosa kami, tutupilah aib-aib kami, dan anugerahilah kami kejujuran, keikhlasan, makrifat, dan mahabbah. Lapangkanlah dada kami, mudahkanlah urusan kami, dan perbaikilah pasangan serta anak-anak kami.
passages.en: (O Allah,) enrich us with what You have made lawful, away from what You have forbidden; with obedience to You, away from disobedience; and with Your bounty, away from all besides You. Lift away our sorrows, forgive our sins, veil our faults, and grant us truthfulness, sincerity, knowledge of You, and love. Expand our breasts, ease our affairs, and set right our spouses and our children.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: وَكُنْ لَنَا بِمَا كُنْتَ بِهِ لِلْمَحْبُوبِينَ، وَأَعْطِنَا فِي هَذِهِ الزِّيَارَةِ أَفْضَلَ مَا تُعْطِي الزَّائِرِينَ، لِعِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
passages.tr: Wa kun lanâ bimâ kunta bihi lil-mahbûbîn, wa a`thinâ fî hâdzihiz-ziyârati afdhala mâ tu`thiz-zâ'irîna, li`ibâdikash-shâlihîn.
passages.id_: Dan jadilah bagi kami sebagaimana Engkau bagi para kekasih-Mu, dan berikanlah kepada kami dalam ziarah ini sebaik-baik apa yang Engkau berikan kepada para peziarah hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh.
passages.en: And be for us as You have been for Your beloved ones, and grant us in this visit the best of what You grant those who visit Your righteous servants.

passages.sub: Visiting the Al Ba Alawi masters at Hawtat al-Ma'la
passages.ar: بِسِرِّ الفَاتِحَةِ إِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
passages.tr: Bisirril-Fâtihah, ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi shallallâhu `alayhi wa âlihi wa sallam.
passages.id_: Dengan rahasia al-Fatihah — ke hadirat Nabi, semoga Allah melimpahkan shalawat dan salam kepada beliau dan keluarga beliau.
passages.en: By the secret of al-Fatihah — to the presence of the Prophet, may Allah bestow prayers and peace upon him and his Family.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا أَعْلَمَ العِلْمِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ a`lamal-`ilm.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai orang-orang yang paling dalam ilmunya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O you most deeply versed in knowledge.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا وَرَثَةَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ waratsatal-anbiyâ'.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai para pewaris nabi-nabi.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O inheritors of the Prophets.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ عَلَوِيٍّ المَالِكِي وَعَلَى وَالِدِكَ عَلَوِيٍّ وَجَدِّكَ عَبَّاسٍ وَآبَاءِكَ الصَّالِحِين.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanâ Muhammadi bni `Alawiyyil-Mâlikî, wa `alâ wâlidika `Alawiyyin wa jaddika `Abbâsin wa âbâ'ikash-shâlihîn.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami Muhammad bin Alwi al-Maliki — dan atas ayahandamu Alwi, kakekmu Abbas, serta leluhurmu yang saleh.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our master Muhammad bin Alawi al-Maliki — and upon your father Alawi, your grandfather Abbas, and your righteous forefathers.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدُ مُحَمَّدُ أَمِينٍ كُتْبِيٍّ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayka wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyid Muhammad Amîn Kutbî.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai Sayyid Muhammad Amin Kutbi.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O Sayyid Muhammad Amin Kutbi.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ يَا سَيِّدَنَا العَرَبِيِّ التَّبَّانِي وَمُحَمَّدٍ نُورٍ سَيْفٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuhu yâ sayyidanal-`Arabiyyit-Tabbânî wa Muhammadin Nûr Sayf.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya, wahai junjungan kami al-Arabi at-Tabbani dan Muhammad Nur Saif.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, O our masters al-Arabi at-Tabbani and Muhammad Nur Sayf.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَى كُلِّ عُلَمَاءِ الحَرَمِ مِمَّنْ خَمَلَ وَمَنْ اشْتَهَرَ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alâ kulli `ulamâ'il-harami mimman khamala wa man isytahar.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas seluruh ulama Tanah Haram — yang tidak dikenal maupun yang termasyhur.
passages.en: Peace be upon all the scholars of the Haram — the unknown among them and the renowned.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَى كُلِّ عُلَمَاءِ الأُمَّةِ مَنْ كَشَفَ اللهُ بِهِمْ الغُمَّةِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alâ kulli `ulamâ'il-ummati man kasyafallâhu bihimul-ghummah.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas seluruh ulama umat ini, yang dengan mereka Allah menyingkapkan kesusahan.
passages.en: Peace be upon all the scholars of the Ummah, through whom Allah has lifted away distress.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and His blessings.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ نَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِهِمْ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنَا العِلْمَ النَّافِعَ وَتَجْمَعَنَا بِهِمْ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ مَعْ صَفْوَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَتَقْضِيَ لَنَا الحَاجَاتِ، وَتُبَلِّغَنَا الأُمْنِيَاتِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma nas'aluka bijâhihim an tarzuqanal-`ilman-nâfi`a wa tajma`anâ bihim fî dâri karâmatika ma` shafwatika min khalqika, wa taqdhiya lanal-hâjâti, wa tuballighanal-umniyât.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, kami memohon kepada-Mu, demi kedudukan mereka, agar Engkau menganugerahi kami ilmu yang bermanfaat, menghimpunkan kami bersama mereka di negeri kemuliaan-Mu bersama hamba-hamba pilihan-Mu, menunaikan hajat-hajat kami, dan menyampaikan kami kepada segala cita-cita.
passages.en: O Allah, we ask You, by their standing, to grant us beneficial knowledge, to gather us with them in the abode of Your honour together with Your chosen ones among Your creation, to fulfil our needs, and to bring us to what we hope for.

passages.sub: Visiting the scholars of Makkah
passages.ar: وَإِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ الفَاتِحَةِ.
passages.tr: Wa ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi, al-Fâtihah.
passages.id_: Dan ke hadirat Nabi — al-Fatihah.
passages.en: And to the presence of the Prophet — al-Fatihah.
